questions.q_en: What are the traditional 'Triple Constraints' (Iron Triangle) that a Construction Project Manager must balance throughout a construction project?
questions.q_bm: Apakah 'Tiga Kekangan Utama' (Triple Constraints) tradisional yang mesti diseimbangkan oleh Pengurus Projek Pembinaan sepanjang pelaksanaan projek?
options_en: Time, Cost, and Scope/Quality
Design, Tender, and Handover
Labour, Plant, and Material
Safety, Environment, and Profit
options_bm: Masa, Kos, dan Skop/Kualiti
Reka Bentuk, Tender, dan Penyerahan
Buruh, Loji, dan Bahan
Keselamatan, Alam Sekitar, dan Keuntungan
questions.exp_en: The Iron Triangle comprises Time, Cost, and Scope (with Quality at its core). Any unapproved change in one constraint directly impacts the others.
questions.exp_bm: Segi Tiga Besi merangkumi Masa, Kos, dan Skop (dengan Kualiti sebagai teras). Sebarang perubahan pada satu kekangan akan memberi kesan langsung kepada kekangan lain.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 — Fundamentals of Project Management

questions.q_en: In the standard construction project life cycle taught in CCPM Module 01, which phase immediately precedes the Tendering/Procurement Phase?
questions.q_bm: Dalam kitaran hayat projek pembinaan standard dalam Modul 01 CCPM, fasa manakah yang berlaku sejurus sebelum Fasa Tender/Perolehan?
options_en: Design Development Phase
Construction Execution Phase
Operation and Maintenance Phase
Defects Liability Phase
options_bm: Fasa Pembangunan Reka Bentuk
Fasa Pelaksanaan Pembinaan
Fasa Operasi dan Penyenggaraan
Fasa Tanggungan Kecacatan
questions.exp_en: The sequential life cycle flows from Inception/Initiation -> Feasibility -> Design Development -> Tendering/Procurement -> Construction -> Handover -> Operation & Maintenance.
questions.exp_bm: Aliran kitaran hayat berurutan bermula dari Permulaan -> Kebolehlaksanaan -> Pembangunan Reka Bentuk -> Tender/Perolehan -> Pembinaan -> Penyerahan -> Operasi & Penyenggaraan.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 — Construction Project Life Cycle

questions.q_en: During which project life-cycle phase are the Statement of Need, Business Case, and Feasibility Study primarily evaluated to decide 'Should we do this project?'
questions.q_bm: Pada fasa kitaran hayat projek manakah Penyataan Keperluan (Statement of Need), Kes Perniagaan, dan Kajian Kebolehlaksanaan dinilai untuk memutuskan 'Patutkah projek ini dilaksanakan?'
options_en: Inception / Initiation Phase
Detailed Construction Phase
Testing and Commissioning Phase
Final Account Close-Out Phase
options_bm: Fasa Permulaan (Inception / Initiation)
Fasa Pembinaan Terperinci
Fasa Pengujian dan Pentauliahan
Fasa Penutupan Akaun Akhir
questions.exp_en: During the Inception/Initiation phase, the client and CPM assess technical, financial, and operational viability before committing major capital.
questions.exp_bm: Semasa fasa Permulaan, klien dan CPM menilai daya maju teknikal, kewangan, dan operasi sebelum meluluskan komitmen modal yang besar.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 & M02 — Project Life Cycle

questions.q_en: Why does the cost of making design changes increase exponentially as a project moves from Inception to Construction?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah kos untuk membuat perubahan reka bentuk meningkat secara mendadak apabila projek bergerak daripada Fasa Permulaan ke Fasa Pembinaan?
options_en: Physical work already built must be demolished, re-procured, and delayed
Architectural fees are fixed only during construction
Local authorities prohibit any variation orders after tender
Insurance premiums double every month during construction
options_bm: Kerja fizikal yang telah dibina terpaksa dirobohkan, diperoleh semula, dan dilewatkan
Yuran arkitek hanya ditetapkan semasa pembinaan
Pihak berkuasa tempatan melarang sebarang arahan perubahan selepas tender
Premium insurans berganda setiap bulan semasa pembinaan
questions.exp_en: In early design, changes only require updating drawings; during construction, changes cause abortive works, material wastage, plant idling, and LAD exposure.
questions.exp_bm: Pada peringkat awal reka bentuk, perubahan hanya melibatkan lukisan; semasa pembinaan, ia menyebabkan kerja terbatal, pembaziran bahan, jentera terbiar, dan risiko LAD.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 — Influence vs. Cost Curve

questions.q_en: What is the primary purpose of a 'Stage Gate' (Control Gate) between consecutive project life-cycle phases?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tujuan utama 'Pintu Peringkat' (Stage Gate) antara fasa-fasa kitaran hayat projek yang berturutan?
options_en: To verify mandatory deliverables and approvals before authorizing resources for the next phase
To calculate the final profit margin of subcontractors
To replace the need for a Project Management Plan
To allow contractors to start site work without building plan approval
options_bm: Untuk mengesahkan serahan wajib dan kelulusan sebelum membenarkan sumber bagi fasa seterusnya
Untuk mengira margin keuntungan akhir subkontraktor
Untuk menggantikan keperluan Pelan Pengurusan Projek
Untuk membenarkan kontraktor memulakan kerja tapak tanpa kelulusan pelan bangunan
questions.exp_en: Stage gates act as formal governance checkpoints ensuring incomplete designs or missing statutory approvals do not cascade into costly construction rework.
questions.exp_bm: Stage gate bertindak sebagai titik semak tadbir urus rasmi bagi memastikan reka bentuk tidak lengkap atau kelulusan berkanun yang tertinggal tidak mencetuskan kerja semula yang mahal.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 — Project Governance & Stage Gates

questions.q_en: How does a 'Project' fundamentally differ from routine 'Operations' in construction management?
questions.q_bm: Bagaimanakah sesuatu 'Projek' berbeza secara asas daripada 'Operasi' rutin dalam pengurusan pembinaan?
options_en: A project is temporary with a defined start/end and creates a unique deliverable
A project is permanent and repeats identical daily tasks indefinitely
Operations require a Performance Bond while projects do not
Operations are governed by Act 520 while projects are not
options_bm: Projek bersifat sementara dengan tarikh mula/tamat yang jelas serta menghasilkan serahan unik
Projek bersifat kekal dan mengulang tugas harian yang sama tanpa had
Operasi memerlukan Bon Pelaksanaan manakala projek tidak
Operasi tertakluk kepada Akta 520 manakala projek tidak
questions.exp_en: A construction project is a temporary endeavour with defined start and completion dates producing a unique facility, whereas facility maintenance post-handover is ongoing operations.
questions.exp_bm: Projek pembinaan ialah usaha sementara dengan tarikh mula dan siap yang jelas bagi menghasilkan fasiliti unik, manakala penyenggaraan selepas serahan ialah operasi berterusan.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 — Definition of Project Management

questions.q_en: Which document serves as the central baseline reference defining how a construction project will be executed, monitored, controlled, and closed?
questions.q_bm: Dokumen manakah yang menjadi rujukan garis dasar utama yang mentakrifkan bagaimana projek pembinaan dilaksanakan, dipantau, dikawal, dan ditutup?
options_en: Project Management Plan (PMP)
Daily Site Diary
Delivery Order (DO) Docket
Variation Order (VO) Valuation Sheet
options_bm: Pelan Pengurusan Projek (PMP)
Diari Tapak Harian
Doket Pesanan Penghantaran
Lembaran Penilaian Arahan Perubahan (VO)
questions.exp_en: The Project Management Plan (PMP) integrates scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, environmental, procurement, and risk baselines into a single master governance document.
questions.exp_bm: Pelan Pengurusan Projek (PMP) menyatukan garis dasar skop, jadual, kos, kualiti, keselamatan, alam sekitar, perolehan, dan risiko ke dalam satu dokumen tadbir urus induk.

questions.q_en: Under the CIDB Competency Standard Qualification Framework (CSQF / CICS), at which competency level is the Certified Construction Project Manager (CCPM) accredited?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Rangka Kerja Kelayakan Standard Kompetensi CIDB (CSQF / CICS), pada tahap kompetensi manakah Pengurus Projek Pembinaan Bertauliah (CCPM) diakreditasikan?
options_en: Level 6
Level 3
Level 4
Level 8
options_bm: Tahap 6
Tahap 3
Tahap 4
Tahap 8
questions.exp_en: CCPM is accredited at Competency Level 6 (Managerial / Professional Project Leadership level) covering Modules 01 through 16.
questions.exp_bm: CCPM diakreditasikan pada Tahap Kompetensi 6 (peringkat kepimpinan pengurusan projek profesional) yang merangkumi Modul 01 hingga 16.
questions.ref: CIDB CICS / CSQF — CCPM Level 6 Standard

questions.q_en: What is the minimum passing mark required for a candidate to be certified 'Competent' in the CIDB CCPM Performance Assessment (PA)?
questions.q_bm: Berapakah markah lulus minimum yang diperlukan oleh calon untuk disahkan 'Kompeten' dalam Penilaian Prestasi (PA) CCPM CIDB?
questions.exp_en: Candidates must achieve at least 70% across the 16-module assessment (1,600 total marks) and submit their bound PA report on time.
questions.exp_bm: Calon mesti mencapai sekurang-kurangnya 70% merentasi penilaian 16 modul (1,600 markah penuh) dan menghantar laporan PA berjilid tepat pada masanya.
questions.ref: CIDB Modular Assessment — Direction to Candidate

questions.q_en: Which activity marks the transition from the Construction Phase to the Handover Phase in a commercial building project?
questions.q_bm: Aktiviti manakah yang menandakan peralihan daripada Fasa Pembinaan kepada Fasa Penyerahan dalam projek bangunan komersial?
options_en: Testing & Commissioning (T&C), Statutory Inspections, and Practical Completion
Appointment of the Quantity Surveyor
Submission of Development Order (DO) to DBKL
Borehole Sub-Surface Soil Investigation
options_bm: Pengujian & Pentauliahan (T&C), Pemeriksaan Berkanun, dan Siap Praktikal (PC)
Pelantikan Juruukur Bahan
Penyerahan Kebenaran Merancang (DO) kepada DBKL
Penyiasatan Tanah Bawah Permukaan (Borehole)
questions.exp_en: Handover is triggered once physical construction, integrated MEP testing & commissioning, and statutory clearances are verified for Practical Completion.
questions.exp_bm: Fasa penyerahan bermula apabila pembinaan fizikal, pengujian & pentauliahan M&E bersepadu, serta pelepasan berkanun disahkan untuk Siap Praktikal.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 & M14 — Life Cycle Transition

questions.q_en: What is the primary distinction between a 'Construction Project Manager (CPM)' appointed by the developer and a 'Site Agent / Construction Manager' employed by a trade contractor?
questions.q_bm: Apakah perbezaan utama antara 'Pengurus Projek Pembinaan (CPM)' yang dilantik pemaju dengan 'Ejen Tapak / Pengurus Pembinaan' yang digajikan kontraktor tred?
options_en: The CPM manages end-to-end project delivery across all phases on behalf of the Client, whereas the Site Agent manages daily site trade execution
The Site Agent approves Development Orders while the CPM mixes concrete
The CPM is only involved after Practical Completion
There is no difference in contractual accountability
options_bm: CPM mengurus penyampaian projek menyeluruh merentasi semua fasa bagi pihak Klien, manakala Ejen Tapak mengurus pelaksanaan kerja harian di tapak
Ejen Tapak meluluskan Kebenaran Merancang manakala CPM membancuh konkrit
CPM hanya terlibat selepas Siap Praktikal
Tiada perbezaan dari segi akauntabiliti kontrak
questions.exp_en: The CPM oversees holistic integration (inception, design, statutory approvals, procurement, cost, time, quality, HSE, and handover) aligned with the Client's business objectives.
questions.exp_bm: CPM menyelia integrasi holistik (permulaan, reka bentuk, kelulusan berkanun, perolehan, kos, masa, kualiti, HSE, dan penyerahan) sejajar dengan objektif perniagaan Klien.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 — Role of Construction Project Manager

questions.q_en: In a RACI responsibility assignment matrix, what does the letter 'A' stand for, and how many 'A's should exist per deliverable?
questions.q_bm: Dalam matriks penugasan tanggungjawab RACI, apakah maksud huruf 'A', dan berapakah bilangan 'A' yang sepatutnya wujud bagi setiap serahan?
options_en: Accountable — exactly ONE person holds final sign-off authority per deliverable
Approved — at least three people must sign every task
Advisory — external consultants with no decision power
Allocated — all site workers assigned to the trade
options_bm: Accountable (Bertanggungjawab Penuh) — tepat SATU individu memegang kuasa pengesahan akhir bagi setiap serahan
Approved — sekurang-kurangnya tiga orang mesti menandatangani setiap tugas
Advisory — perunding luar tanpa kuasa keputusan
Allocated — semua pekerja tapak yang ditugaskan
questions.exp_en: Each deliverable must have exactly one 'Accountable' owner to prevent decision paralysis or finger-pointing, while multiple team members can be 'Responsible' (R).
questions.exp_bm: Setiap serahan mesti mempunyai tepat satu pemilik 'Accountable' bagi mengelakkan kekeliruan keputusan, manakala beberapa ahli pasukan boleh menjadi 'Responsible' (R).

questions.q_en: Which governance document formally authorizes the Construction Project Manager to apply organizational resources to project activities and defines authority limits?
questions.q_bm: Dokumen tadbir urus manakah yang memberi kuasa rasmi kepada Pengurus Projek Pembinaan untuk menggunakan sumber organisasi dan menetapkan had kuasanya?
options_en: Project Charter
Bill of Quantities (BQ)
Certificate of Making Good Defects (CMGD)
Method Statement for Piling
options_bm: Piagam Projek (Project Charter)
Senarai Kuantiti (BQ)
Perakuan Siap Membaiki Kecacatan (CMGD)
Pernyataan Kaedah Kerja Cerucuk
questions.exp_en: The Project Charter formally establishes the project, names the CPM, and defines decision-making authority and escalation thresholds.
questions.exp_bm: Piagam Projek menubuhkan projek secara rasmi, menamakan CPM, serta mentakrifkan kuasa membuat keputusan dan had eskalasi.

questions.q_en: In a Design-and-Build (D&B) procurement arrangement, who bears single-point legal and technical responsibility for ensuring the detailed design meets the Employer's Requirements?
questions.q_bm: Dalam pengaturan perolehan Reka dan Bina (Design and Build), siapakah yang menanggung tanggungjawab perundangan dan teknikal titik tunggal bagi memastikan reka bentuk terperinci memenuhi Kehendak Majikan?
options_en: The Design-and-Build Contractor
The Quantity Surveyor alone
The Local Authority (DBKL)
The Material Suppliers
options_bm: Kontraktor Reka dan Bina (D&B)
Juruukur Bahan sahaja
Pihak Berkuasa Tempatan (DBKL)
Pembekal Bahan Binaan
questions.exp_en: Under D&B contracts, design and construction liabilities are unified under the D&B Contractor, reducing employer exposure to design-vs-construction blame disputes.
questions.exp_bm: Di bawah kontrak D&B, liabiliti reka bentuk dan pembinaan disatukan di bawah Kontraktor D&B, mengurangkan pendedahan majikan terhadap pertikaian antara pereka dan pembina.

questions.q_en: When a developer acts as both Employer and Named D&B Contractor (as in the Perintis Development Berhad case study), what governance measure prevents conflict of interest?
questions.q_bm: Apabila pemaju bertindak sebagai Majikan dan juga Kontraktor D&B Dinamakan (seperti dalam kajian kes Perintis Development Berhad), apakah langkah tadbir urus bagi mengelakkan konflik kepentingan?
options_en: Segregating Employer governance/audit oversight from D&B execution and appointing an Independent Checking Engineer (ICE)
Eliminating all QA/QC and HSE inspections to save time
Allowing site supervisors to approve their own Variation Orders
Skipping statutory submissions to local authorities
options_bm: Mengasingkan tadbir urus/audit Majikan daripada pelaksanaan D&B serta melantik Jurutera Penyemak Bebas (ICE)
Menghapuskan semua pemeriksaan QA/QC dan HSE untuk menjimatkan masa
Membenarkan penyelia tapak meluluskan Arahan Perubahan mereka sendiri
Melangkau penyerahan berkanun kepada pihak berkuasa tempatan
questions.exp_en: Functional separation, independent QA/HSE audits, and an Independent Checking Engineer (ICE) ensure objective compliance and financial transparency.
questions.exp_bm: Pengasingan fungsi, audit QA/HSE bebas, dan Jurutera Penyemak Bebas (ICE) memastikan pematuhan objektif dan ketelusan kewangan.

questions.q_en: Which set of core competencies must a Level 6 CCPM demonstrate according to CIDB's competency framework?
questions.q_bm: Set kompetensi teras manakah yang mesti ditunjukkan oleh CCPM Tahap 6 mengikut rangka kerja kompetensi CIDB?
options_en: Technical project management knowledge, leadership/people skills, and strategic business/regulatory awareness
Only bricklaying and concrete mixing skills
Only architectural 3D rendering skills
Only corporate tax accounting
options_bm: Pengetahuan teknikal pengurusan projek, kemahiran kepimpinan/insan, dan kesedaran strategik perniagaan/perundangan
Kemahiran mengikat bata dan membancuh konkrit sahaja
Kemahiran persembahan 3D seni bina sahaja
Perakaunan cukai korporat sahaja
questions.exp_en: CCPM Level 6 integrates technical controls (time, cost, quality, HSE), leadership/stakeholder management, and statutory/commercial alignment.
questions.exp_bm: CCPM Tahap 6 menggabungkan kawalan teknikal (masa, kos, kualiti, HSE), kepimpinan/pengurusan pihak berkepentingan, serta penjajaran perundangan/komersial.

questions.q_en: In construction terminology, what does 'Constructability' (or Buildability) mean during the design phase?
questions.q_bm: Dalam terminologi pembinaan, apakah maksud 'Kebolehbinaan' (Constructability / Buildability) semasa fasa reka bentuk?
options_en: Integrating construction knowledge early into design to optimize ease, safety, speed, and cost of site execution
Designing the tallest possible building regardless of cost
Postponing all engineering calculations until construction starts
Using only imported custom-made materials
options_bm: Mengintegrasikan pengetahuan pembinaan lebih awal ke dalam reka bentuk untuk mengoptimumkan kemudahan, keselamatan, kelajuan, dan kos di tapak
Mereka bentuk bangunan tertinggi tanpa mengira kos
Menangguhkan semua pengiraan kejuruteraan sehingga pembinaan bermula
Menggunakan bahan tempahan khas yang diimport sahaja
questions.exp_en: Early constructability reviews (e.g., standardized grids, precast IBS elements, clear crane access) reduce site labour, rework, and schedule duration.
questions.exp_bm: Semakan kebolehbinaan awal (seperti grid seragam, komponen pratuang IBS, laluan kren jelas) mengurangkan tenaga buruh tapak, kerja semula, dan tempoh jadual.

questions.q_en: What is the role of the Principal Submitting Person (PSP) in a Malaysian building development project?
questions.q_bm: Apakah peranan Orang Utama Yang Mengemukakan (PSP) dalam projek pembangunan bangunan di Malaysia?
options_en: A registered Professional Architect or Professional Engineer responsible for statutory plan submissions, supervision, and issuing CCC (Borang F)
The main supplier of ready-mix concrete
The site security supervisor
The bank loan officer
options_bm: Arkitek Profesional atau Jurutera Profesional berdaftar yang bertanggungjawab mengemukakan pelan berkanun, mengawasi, dan mengeluarkan CCC (Borang F)
Pembekal utama konkrit siap bancuh
Penyelia keselamatan tapak
Pegawai pinjaman bank
questions.exp_en: Under Act 133 and UBBL 1984, the PSP coordinates all Submitting Persons (SPs), secures statutory approvals, and certifies completion via Borang F.
questions.exp_bm: Di bawah Akta 133 dan UBBL 1984, PSP menyelaras semua Orang Yang Mengemukakan (SP), mendapatkan kelulusan berkanun, dan memperakui penyiapan melalui Borang F.

questions.q_en: Why should a Construction Project Manager maintain an explicit 'Assumptions and Constraints Log' from project inception?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah Pengurus Projek Pembinaan perlu menyelenggara 'Log Andaian dan Kekangan' secara eksplisit sejak permulaan projek?
options_en: To track unverified planning assumptions with assigned owners and closure dates before irreversible site work begins
To hide project risks from the client
To replace the contract agreement
To avoid paying statutory levies
options_bm: Untuk menjejak andaian perancangan yang belum disahkan beserta pemilik dan tarikh tutup sebelum kerja tapak dimulakan
Untuk menyembunyikan risiko projek daripada klien
Untuk menggantikan perjanjian kontrak
Untuk mengelak pembayaran levi berkanun
questions.exp_en: Unverified assumptions (e.g., assumed soil bearing capacity or utility locations) are major triggers of variations and delays if not closed early.
questions.exp_bm: Andaian yang belum disahkan (seperti keupayaan galas tanah atau lokasi utiliti) ialah pencetus utama arahan perubahan dan kelewatan jika tidak ditutup awal.

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian professional board regulates the registration and practice of Professional Engineers (Ir.) involved in construction projects?
questions.q_bm: Lembaga profesional Malaysia manakah yang mengawal selia pendaftaran dan amalan Jurutera Profesional (Ir.) yang terlibat dalam projek pembinaan?
options_en: Board of Engineers Malaysia (BEM / LJM)
Board of Architects Malaysia (LAM)
Board of Quantity Surveyors Malaysia (BQSM)
Malaysian Board of Technologists (MBOT)
options_bm: Lembaga Jurutera Malaysia (BEM / LJM)
Lembaga Arkitek Malaysia (LAM)
Lembaga Juruukur Bahan Malaysia (BQSM)
Lembaga Teknologis Malaysia (MBOT)
questions.exp_en: BEM (Lembaga Jurutera Malaysia) administers the Registration of Engineers Act 1967, while LAM regulates Architects and BQSM regulates Quantity Surveyors.
questions.exp_bm: BEM (Lembaga Jurutera Malaysia) mentadbir Akta Pendaftaran Jurutera 1967, manakala LAM mengawal selia Arkitek dan BQSM mengawal selia Juruukur Bahan.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 — Malaysian Construction Regulatory Bodies

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian Act of Parliament established the Construction Industry Development Board (CIDB) to regulate and develop the construction industry?
questions.q_bm: Akta Parlimen Malaysia manakah yang menubuhkan Lembaga Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia (CIDB) untuk mengawal selia dan membangunkan industri pembinaan?
options_en: Lembaga Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia Act 1994 (Act 520)
Street, Drainage and Building Act 1974 (Act 133)
Town and Country Planning Act 1976 (Act 172)
Occupational Safety and Health Act 1994 (Act 514)
options_bm: Akta Lembaga Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia 1994 (Akta 520)
Akta Jalan, Parit dan Bangunan 1974 (Akta 133)
Akta Perancangan Bandar dan Desa 1976 (Akta 172)
Akta Keselamatan dan Kesihatan Pekerjaan 1994 (Akta 514)
questions.exp_en: Act 520 (enacted 1994, significantly strengthened by Amendment Act A1407 in 2011, effective 1 June 2015) governs CIDB's regulatory powers.
questions.exp_bm: Akta 520 (digubal 1994, diperkukuh melalui Akta Pindaan A1407 pada 2011, berkuat kuasa 1 Jun 2015) mengawal selia kuasa kawal selia CIDB.

questions.q_en: Under Section 25 of CIDB Act 520, which contractor registration grade is mandatory to execute a building project exceeding RM10,000,000 (such as the RM180.5M Setiawangsa Mall)?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 25 Akta CIDB 520, gred pendaftaran kontraktor manakah yang wajib untuk melaksanakan projek bangunan melebihi RM10,000,000 (seperti Pusat Beli-Belah Setiawangsa RM180.5J)?
options_en: Grade G7 (Unlimited tendering capacity)
Grade G5 (Up to RM5,000,000)
Grade G6 (Up to RM10,000,000)
Grade G4 (Up to RM3,000,000)
options_bm: Gred G7 (Keupayaan menender tanpa had)
Gred G5 (Sehingga RM5,000,000)
Gred G6 (Sehingga RM10,000,000)
Gred G4 (Sehingga RM3,000,000)
questions.exp_en: CIDB contractor grades are: G1 (<=RM200k), G2 (<=RM500k), G3 (<=RM1M), G4 (<=RM3M), G5 (<=RM5M), G6 (<=RM10M), and G7 (Unlimited >RM10M).
questions.exp_bm: Gred kontraktor CIDB ialah: G1 (<=RM200k), G2 (<=RM500k), G3 (<=RM1J), G4 (<=RM3J), G5 (<=RM5J), G6 (<=RM10J), dan G7 (Tanpa Had >RM10J).

questions.q_en: What is the maximum tendering capacity for a CIDB Grade G6 registered contractor?
questions.q_bm: Berapakah had keupayaan menender maksimum bagi kontraktor yang berdaftar dengan CIDB Gred G6?
options_en: Not exceeding RM10,000,000.00
Not exceeding RM5,000,000.00
Not exceeding RM3,000,000.00
Unlimited
options_bm: Tidak melebihi RM10,000,000.00
Tidak melebihi RM5,000,000.00
Tidak melebihi RM3,000,000.00
Tanpa had
questions.exp_en: Grade G6 contractors are permitted to undertake construction contracts up to RM10,000,000.00; projects above RM10M strictly require Grade G7.
questions.exp_bm: Kontraktor Gred G6 dibenarkan melaksanakan kontrak pembinaan sehingga RM10,000,000.00; projek melebihi RM10J wajib menggunakan Gred G7.

questions.q_en: Under Section 29 of CIDB Act 520 (as amended), what is the penalty upon conviction for a person or company undertaking construction works without a valid CIDB contractor registration certificate?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 29 Akta CIDB 520 (pindaan), apakah penalti apabila disabitkan kesalahan bagi mana-mana orang atau syarikat yang menjalankan kerja pembinaan tanpa perakuan pendaftaran kontraktor CIDB yang sah?
options_en: A fine of not less than RM10,000 and not more than RM100,000
A verbal warning only
A flat compound of RM500
Automatic award of a Grade G1 license
options_bm: Denda tidak kurang daripada RM10,000 dan tidak melebihi RM100,000
Amaran lisan sahaja
Kompaun tetap sebanyak RM500
Pemberian lesen Gred G1 secara automatik
questions.exp_en: Amendment Act 2011 raised the maximum penalty for unregistered contracting from RM10,000 to between RM10,000 and RM100,000, plus stop-work powers.
questions.exp_bm: Akta Pindaan 2011 menaikkan penalti menjalankan kerja tanpa pendaftaran daripada maksimum RM10,000 kepada antara RM10,000 hingga RM100,000, selain kuasa henti kerja.
questions.ref: Akta 520 Section 29 — Offence of Unregistered Contracting

questions.q_en: Which three primary registration categories does CIDB use to classify contractor technical specialization?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tiga kategori pendaftaran utama yang digunakan oleh CIDB untuk mengklasifikasikan pengkhususan teknikal kontraktor?
options_en: B (Building), CE (Civil Engineering), and ME (Mechanical & Electrical)
A (Architecture), S (Surveying), and P (Planning)
H (Housing), I (Infrastructure), and T (Tourism)
R (Roads), W (Water), and E (Energy)
options_bm: B (Pembinaan Bangunan), CE (Kejuruteraan Awam), dan ME (Mekanikal & Elektrikal)
A (Seni Bina), S (Ukur), dan P (Perancangan)
H (Perumahan), I (Infrastruktur), dan T (Pelancongan)
R (Jalan), W (Air), dan E (Tenaga)
questions.exp_en: CIDB classifies contractors into Category B (Building), Category CE (Civil Engineering), and Category ME (Mechanical & Electrical), plus Facility (F) categories.
questions.exp_bm: CIDB mengklasifikasikan kontraktor kepada Kategori B (Bangunan), Kategori CE (Kejuruteraan Awam), dan Kategori ME (Mekanikal & Elektrikal), serta kategori Fasiliti (F).

questions.q_en: What is the purpose of CIDB's 'SPKK' (Sijil Perolehan Kerja Kerajaan)?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tujuan 'SPKK' (Sijil Perolehan Kerja Kerajaan) yang dikeluarkan oleh CIDB?
options_en: To certify a registered contractor's eligibility to participate in government/public-sector procurement tenders
To replace the Building Plan approval from DBKL
To certify individual foreign general labourers
To approve environmental impact assessments
options_bm: Untuk memperakui kelayakan kontraktor berdaftar menyertai tender perolehan kerajaan/sektor awam
Untuk menggantikan kelulusan Pelan Bangunan daripada DBKL
Untuk memperakui buruh am asing secara individu
Untuk meluluskan penilaian impak alam sekitar
questions.exp_en: While PPK (Perakuan Pendaftaran Kontraktor) is mandatory for all private and public works, SPKK is specifically required for government procurement tenders.
questions.exp_bm: Walaupun PPK wajib bagi semua kerja swasta dan awam, SPKK diperlukan secara khusus bagi menyertai tender perolehan kerajaan.

questions.q_en: What is CIDB 'SCORE' (Contractor Competency and Capability Evaluation Programme)?
questions.q_bm: Apakah program 'SCORE' CIDB (Program Penilaian Keupayaan dan Kemampuan Kontraktor)?
options_en: A star-rating diagnostic tool measuring contractor business, financial, technical, and management capability
A software for calculating concrete slump
A fire alarm testing checklist
A payroll tax deduction table
options_bm: Alat diagnostik penarafan bintang yang mengukur keupayaan perniagaan, kewangan, teknikal, dan pengurusan kontraktor
Perisian untuk mengira kemerosotan (slump) konkrit
Senarai semak ujian penggera kebakaran
Jadual potongan cukai gaji
questions.exp_en: SCORE evaluates contractors across 7 parameters (financial, technical, project management, procurement, best practices, etc.) on a 1-to-5-star scale.
questions.exp_bm: SCORE menilai kontraktor merentasi 7 parameter (kewangan, teknikal, pengurusan projek, perolehan, amalan terbaik, dll.) pada skala 1 hingga 5 bintang.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 — CIDB Industry Development Programmes

questions.q_en: Does CIDB Act 520 apply to foreign contractors undertaking construction works in Malaysia?
questions.q_bm: Adakah Akta CIDB 520 terpakai kepada kontraktor asing yang menjalankan kerja pembinaan di Malaysia?
options_en: Yes — foreign contractors must obtain a CIDB Foreign Contractor Registration Certificate before executing any construction work in Malaysia
No — foreign contractors are completely exempt from Malaysian laws
Only if the project is below RM1 million
Only if the project is residential
options_bm: Ya — kontraktor asing mesti memperoleh Perakuan Pendaftaran Kontraktor Asing CIDB sebelum menjalankan sebarang kerja pembinaan di Malaysia
Tidak — kontraktor asing dikecualikan sepenuhnya daripada undang-undang Malaysia
Hanya jika projek bernilai di bawah RM1 juta
Hanya jika projek tersebut projek perumahan
questions.exp_en: Under Act 520, no foreign contractor may undertake or execute construction works in Malaysia without valid CIDB registration.
questions.exp_bm: Di bawah Akta 520, tiada kontraktor asing boleh mengakujanji atau melaksanakan kerja pembinaan di Malaysia tanpa pendaftaran CIDB yang sah.

questions.q_en: What are the three core pillars strengthened by the CIDB Act 520 (Amendment 2011) implemented on 1 June 2015?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tiga teras utama yang diperkukuh oleh Akta CIDB 520 (Pindaan 2011) yang berkuat kuasa pada 1 Jun 2015?
options_en: Registration/accreditation of construction personnel, compliance standards for building materials, and safety of buildings/works
Bank interest rates, income tax, and customs tariffs
Land acquisition, strata titles, and property stamp duty
Hotel licensing, retail hours, and parking fees
options_bm: Pendaftaran/akreditasi personel binaan, pematuhan standard bahan binaan, dan keselamatan bangunan/kerja pembinaan
Kadar faedah bank, cukai pendapatan, dan tarif kastam
Pengambilan tanah, hakmilik strata, dan duti setem hartanah
Pelesenan hotel, waktu operasi runcit, dan caj parkir
questions.exp_en: The 2011 Amendment focused specifically on personnel accreditation (Sec 33A), Fourth Schedule material certification (Sec 33C), and building/work safety (Sec 34B).
questions.exp_bm: Pindaan 2011 memberi tumpuan khusus kepada akreditasi personel (Sek 33A), pensijilan bahan Jadual Keempat (Sek 33C), dan keselamatan bangunan/kerja (Sek 34B).

questions.q_en: Under CIDB Act 520, when is a construction project exempt from mandatory contractor registration?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Akta CIDB 520, bilakah sesuatu kerja pembinaan dikecualikan daripada pendaftaran kontraktor wajib?
options_en: Only specific minor exemptions gazetted by the Minister (such as small self-built owner-occupied works below prescribed thresholds)
All private shopping malls are exempt
All Design-and-Build contracts are exempt
Any project completed in less than 3 years is exempt
options_bm: Hanya pengecualian kecil tertentu yang diwartakan oleh Menteri (seperti kerja binaan sendiri pemilik di bawah had ditetapkan)
Semua pusat beli-belah swasta dikecualikan
Semua kontrak Reka dan Bina dikecualikan
Mana-mana projek yang siap kurang daripada 3 tahun dikecualikan
questions.exp_en: Commercial, industrial, and public construction works require valid CIDB registration; exemptions apply strictly to narrow gazetted exceptions.
questions.exp_bm: Kerja pembinaan komersial, industri, dan awam memerlukan pendaftaran CIDB yang sah; pengecualian hanya terpakai kepada kes terhad yang diwartakan.

questions.q_en: Under Section 33 of CIDB Act 520, what is the mandatory requirement for EVERY construction worker (general and skilled) before entering a construction site?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 33 Akta CIDB 520, apakah syarat wajib bagi SETIAP pekerja binaan (am dan mahir) sebelum memasuki tapak bina?
options_en: Must be registered with CIDB and hold a valid Construction Personnel Registration Card (Green Card)
Must hold a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering
Must be a member of REHDA
Must have 15 years of overseas experience
options_bm: Mesti berdaftar dengan CIDB dan memegang Kad Pendaftaran Personel Binaan (Kad Hijau) yang sah
Mesti memiliki Ijazah Sarjana Muda Kejuruteraan Awam
Mesti menjadi ahli REHDA
Mesti mempunyai 15 tahun pengalaman luar negara
questions.exp_en: Every construction personnel on site must hold an active CIDB Green Card, which provides basic safety induction (SICW) and takaful protection.
questions.exp_bm: Setiap personel binaan di tapak wajib memiliki Kad Hijau CIDB yang aktif, yang merangkumi kursus induksi keselamatan (SICW) dan perlindungan takaful.
questions.ref: Akta 520 Section 33 — Registration of Construction Personnel

questions.q_en: Under Section 33A of Act 520, which two groups listed in the Third Schedule must hold valid CIDB Skill Competency Accreditation (SKK)?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 33A Akta 520, dua kumpulan manakah yang disenaraikan dalam Jadual Ketiga yang wajib memegang Perakuan Kecekapan Kemahiran (SKK) CIDB?
options_en: Construction site supervisors and skilled construction workers (e.g., crane operators, scaffolders, welders, electricians)
Security guards and canteen cooks
Retail store cashiers and mall cleaners
Bank auditors and external lawyers
options_bm: Penyelia tapak bina dan pekerja binaan mahir (cth. pengendali kren, pemasang perancah, pengimpal, juruelektrik)
Pengawal keselamatan dan tukang masak kantin
Juruwang kedai runcit dan tukang cuci pusat beli-belah
Juruaudit bank dan peguam luar
questions.exp_en: Section 33A requires all construction site supervisors and Third Schedule skilled trades to be accredited and certified by CIDB.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 33A mewajibkan semua penyelia tapak bina dan pekerja tred mahir dalam Jadual Ketiga diakreditasi dan diperakui oleh CIDB.

questions.q_en: What is the maximum fine under Section 33A of Act 520 imposed on BOTH an unaccredited skilled worker/supervisor AND the employer who engages them?
questions.q_bm: Berapakah denda maksimum di bawah Seksyen 33A Akta 520 yang dikenakan ke atas KEDUA-DUA pekerja mahir/penyelia tidak bertauliah DAN majikan yang menggaji mereka?
options_en: A fine not exceeding RM5,000
A fine of RM500,000
A fine of RM100
No fine applies to the employer
options_bm: Denda tidak melebihi RM5,000
Denda sebanyak RM500,000
Denda sebanyak RM100
Tiada denda dikenakan kepada majikan
questions.exp_en: Section 33A imposes a fine up to RM5,000 on any person working without required accreditation and the exact same penalty on the employer.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 33A mengenakan denda sehingga RM5,000 ke atas individu yang bekerja tanpa akreditasi wajib serta penalti yang sama ke atas majikannya.

questions.q_en: Under Section 34 of CIDB Act 520, what is the contract value threshold above which a contractor MUST declare the project to CIDB and pay the statutory levy?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 34 Akta CIDB 520, berapakah nilai ambang kontrak di mana kontraktor WAJIB mengisytiharkan projek kepada CIDB dan membayar levi berkanun?
options_en: Contract sum exceeding RM500,000.00
Contract sum exceeding RM50,000.00
Contract sum exceeding RM10,000,000.00
Only projects above RM100,000,000.00
options_bm: Jumlah harga kontrak melebihi RM500,000.00
Jumlah harga kontrak melebihi RM50,000.00
Jumlah harga kontrak melebihi RM10,000,000.00
Hanya projek melebihi RM100,000,000.00
questions.exp_en: Every construction contract exceeding RM500,000 must be notified to CIDB and is subject to the statutory CIDB levy.
questions.exp_bm: Setiap kontrak pembinaan yang melebihi RM500,000 mesti dimaklumkan kepada CIDB dan tertakluk kepada levi berkanun CIDB.

questions.q_en: What is the current statutory CIDB levy rate imposed on construction contracts exceeding RM500,000 under Section 34 of Act 520?
questions.q_bm: Berapakah kadar levi berkanun CIDB semasa yang dikenakan ke atas kontrak pembinaan melebihi RM500,000 di bawah Seksyen 34 Akta 520?
options_en: 0.125% of the contract sum
0.25% of the contract sum
1.0% of the contract sum
6.0% of the contract sum
options_bm: 0.125% daripada jumlah harga kontrak
0.25% daripada jumlah harga kontrak
1.0% daripada jumlah harga kontrak
6.0% daripada jumlah harga kontrak
questions.exp_en: The CIDB levy rate is 0.125% (one-eighth of one percent) of the total contract value.
questions.exp_bm: Kadar levi CIDB ialah 0.125% (satu perlapan peratus) daripada jumlah keseluruhan nilai kontrak.

questions.q_en: For the Setiawangsa Seven-Storey Shopping Centre with a contract sum of RM180,500,000.00, how much is the statutory CIDB levy payable?
questions.q_bm: Bagi projek Pusat Beli-Belah 7 Tingkat Setiawangsa dengan harga kontrak RM180,500,000.00, berapakah jumlah levi berkanun CIDB yang perlu dibayar?
questions.ref: Akta 520 Section 34 & PA Case Study M01

questions.q_en: Which official CIDB form must a contractor submit to declare a new construction project award, and within what timeframe?
questions.q_bm: Borang rasmi CIDB manakah yang mesti dikemukakan oleh kontraktor untuk mengisytiharkan penganugerahan projek baharu, dan dalam tempoh berapa lama?
options_en: Form CIDB L1/96 within 14 days from the date of award (or before work commences)
Form Borang F within 6 months after completion
Form JKJ 103 within 30 days after piling
Form CIDB G7 within 1 year of DLP
options_bm: Borang CIDB L1/96 dalam tempoh 14 hari dari tarikh penganugerahan (atau sebelum kerja bermula)
Borang F dalam tempoh 6 bulan selepas siap
Borang JKJ 103 dalam tempoh 30 hari selepas kerja cerucuk
Borang CIDB G7 dalam tempoh 1 tahun DLP
questions.exp_en: Contractors must notify CIDB using Form CIDB L1/96 within 14 days of letter of award (and before site work starts) together with contract award proof.
questions.exp_bm: Kontraktor wajib memaklumkan CIDB menggunakan Borang CIDB L1/96 dalam tempoh 14 hari dari surat setuju terima (dan sebelum kerja tapak bermula).

questions.q_en: What is the penalty under Section 34 of Act 520 if a contractor fails to declare a construction project exceeding RM500,000 to CIDB?
questions.q_bm: Apakah penalti di bawah Seksyen 34 Akta 520 sekiranya kontraktor gagal mengisytiharkan projek pembinaan melebihi RM500,000 kepada CIDB?
options_en: A fine not exceeding RM50,000
A fine of RM1,000 only
Automatic cancellation of the Building Plan
No penalty if the project finishes on time
options_bm: Denda tidak melebihi RM50,000
Denda RM1,000 sahaja
Pembatalan automatik Pelan Bangunan
Tiada denda jika projek siap mengikut jadual
questions.exp_en: Failure to notify/declare a project under Section 34(1) is an offence punishable on conviction by a fine not exceeding RM50,000.
questions.exp_bm: Kegagalan memaklumkan/mengisytiharkan projek di bawah Seksyen 34(1) ialah satu kesalahan yang boleh didenda tidak melebihi RM50,000 apabila disabitkan.

questions.q_en: What is the statutory penalty under Section 34 of Act 520 for failing to pay the assessed CIDB levy?
questions.q_bm: Apakah penalti berkanun di bawah Seksyen 34 Akta 520 bagi kegagalan membayar levi CIDB yang telah ditaksirkan?
options_en: A fine not exceeding RM50,000 OR four (4) times the amount of levy payable, whichever is higher
A flat penalty of RM5,000
Deduction from the Architect's professional fee
Suspension of municipal water supply
options_bm: Denda tidak melebihi RM50,000 ATAU empat (4) kali ganda jumlah levi yang kena dibayar, mengikut mana yang lebih tinggi
Penalti tetap RM5,000
Potongan daripada yuran profesional Arkitek
Penggantungan bekalan air perbandaran
questions.exp_en: For a RM225,625 levy (Setiawangsa Mall), 4× the levy equals RM902,500—far higher than RM50,000—making timely levy payment critical.
questions.exp_bm: Bagi levi RM225,625 (Pusat Beli-Belah Setiawangsa), 4× levi bersamaan RM902,500—jauh lebih tinggi daripada RM50,000—menjadikan bayaran levi tepat masa amat kritikal.

questions.q_en: Who is legally responsible for paying the CIDB levy on a construction contract under Section 34 of Act 520?
questions.q_bm: Siapakah yang bertanggungjawab secara sah di sisi undang-undang untuk membayar levi CIDB bagi sesuatu kontrak pembinaan di bawah Seksyen 34 Akta 520?
options_en: The Main Contractor executing the contract (who typically prices it into Preliminaries)
The Jabatan Bomba officer
The individual retail shop tenants
The material testing laboratory
options_bm: Kontraktor Utama yang melaksanakan kontrak (yang lazimnya memasukkannya dalam item Preliminari)
Pegawai Jabatan Bomba
Penyewa kedai runcit individu
Makmal pengujian bahan
questions.exp_en: Section 34 places the statutory obligation to declare and pay the 0.125% levy squarely on the registered contractor undertaking the contract.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 34 meletakkan kewajipan berkanun untuk mengisytihar dan membayar levi 0.125% secara langsung ke atas kontraktor berdaftar yang melaksanakan kontrak.

questions.q_en: Under Section 33C of CIDB Act 520, what certificate must accompany construction materials listed in the Fourth Schedule before they can be dealt with or used on site?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 33C Akta CIDB 520, perakuan manakah yang mesti mengiringi bahan binaan yang disenaraikan dalam Jadual Keempat sebelum ia boleh diurusniagakan atau digunakan di tapak?
options_en: CIDB Perakuan Pematuhan Standard (PPS) / Certificate of Standard Compliance
Certificate of Practical Completion (CPC)
Development Order (DO)
Certificate of Making Good Defects (CMGD)
options_bm: Perakuan Pematuhan Standard (PPS) CIDB
Perakuan Siap Praktikal (CPC)
Kebenaran Merancang (DO)
Perakuan Siap Membaiki Kecacatan (CMGD)
questions.exp_en: Section 33C prohibits dealing with or using uncertified Fourth Schedule materials; valid CIDB PPS (backed by SIRIM/accredited testing) is mandatory.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 33C melarang urusan atau penggunaan bahan Jadual Keempat yang tidak diperakui; PPS CIDB yang sah (disokong ujian SIRIM/makmal bertauliah) adalah wajib.

questions.q_en: What is the statutory fine upon conviction under Section 33D of Act 520 for dealing with construction materials specified in the Fourth Schedule without CIDB certification?
questions.q_bm: Berapakah denda berkanun apabila disabitkan kesalahan di bawah Seksyen 33D Akta 520 kerana berurusan dengan bahan binaan dalam Jadual Keempat tanpa pensijilan CIDB?
options_en: A fine of not less than RM10,000 and not more than RM500,000
A fine of RM500 only
A fine not exceeding RM2,000
No financial penalty, only a warning letter
options_bm: Denda tidak kurang daripada RM10,000 dan tidak melebihi RM500,000
Denda RM500 sahaja
Denda tidak melebihi RM2,000
Tiada penalti kewangan, hanya surat amaran
questions.exp_en: Section 33D imposes heavy penalties (RM10,000 to RM500,000) to prevent substandard local or dumped imported building materials from entering Malaysian sites.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 33D mengenakan penalti berat (RM10,000 hingga RM500,000) bagi menghalang bahan binaan tempatan bermutu rendah atau bahan import lambakan memasuki tapak bina Malaysia.

questions.q_en: Which of the following building materials are regulated under the Fourth Schedule of CIDB Act 520?
questions.q_bm: Antara bahan binaan berikut, yang manakah dikawal selia di bawah Jadual Keempat Akta CIDB 520?
options_en: Steel reinforcement bars, Portland cement, structural steel sections, ceramic tiles, sanitary wares, and fire-rated doors
Office stationery, printer paper, and whiteboard markers
Temporary site office furniture and pantry appliances
Landscaping grass turf and ornamental flower pots
options_bm: Bar tetulang keluli, simen Portland, keratan keluli struktur, jubin seramik, kelengkapan sanitari, dan pintu rintangan api
Alat tulis pejabat, kertas pencetak, dan pen penanda
Perabot pejabat tapak sementara dan peralatan pantri
Rumput landskap dan pasu bunga hiasan
questions.exp_en: The Fourth Schedule covers structural, architectural, and safety-critical materials (steel, cement, tiles, glass, sanitary ware, pipes, cables, fire doors).
questions.exp_bm: Jadual Keempat merangkumi bahan struktur, seni bina, dan kritikal keselamatan (keluli, simen, jubin, kaca, sanitari, paip, kabel, pintu rintangan api).
questions.ref: Akta 520 Fourth Schedule — Standards for Construction Materials

questions.q_en: Why was Section 33C of Act 520 introduced to regulate BOTH imported and locally manufactured construction materials equally?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah Seksyen 33C Akta 520 diperkenalkan untuk mengawal selia KEDUA-DUA bahan binaan import dan keluaran tempatan secara saksama?
options_en: Because Customs Orders previously only regulated imports, and uniform standards ensure WTO compliance while stopping substandard local materials
To ban all locally manufactured cement in Malaysia
To allow imported materials to bypass SIRIM testing
To increase import duties on foreign steel
options_bm: Kerana Perintah Kastam sebelum ini hanya mengawal import, dan standard seragam memastikan pematuhan WTO sambil menyekat bahan tempatan bermutu rendah
Untuk mengharamkan semua simen keluaran tempatan di Malaysia
Untuk membenarkan bahan import melangkau ujian SIRIM
Untuk menaikkan duti import ke atas keluli asing
questions.exp_en: Equal regulatory standards for local and imported materials ensure non-discrimination under World Trade Organization (WTO) rules and holistic quality assurance.
questions.exp_bm: Standard kawal selia yang sama bagi bahan tempatan dan import memastikan tiada diskriminasi di bawah peraturan WTO serta jaminan kualiti menyeluruh.

questions.q_en: Under Section 34B of CIDB Act 520, what powers does CIDB possess if a contractor breaches building or construction site safety duties?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 34B Akta CIDB 520, apakah kuasa yang dimiliki CIDB sekiranya kontraktor melanggar kewajipan keselamatan bangunan atau tapak bina?
options_en: Immediately stop construction work, inspect at the contractor's cost, order specified rectification works, or order demolition of defective parts
Only send a polite reminder email after 6 months
Confiscate the developer's land title permanently
Transfer the contract to the architect
options_bm: Menghentikan kerja pembinaan serta-merta, memeriksa atas kos kontraktor, mengarahkan kerja pembaikan tertentu, atau mengarahkan perobohan bahagian cacat
Hanya menghantar e-mel peringatan sopan selepas 6 bulan
Merampas hakmilik tanah pemaju secara kekal
Memindahkan kontrak kepada arkitek
questions.exp_en: Section 34B grants CIDB direct statutory enforcement powers including immediate Stop-Work Orders (SWO) and demolition orders at the contractor's expense.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 34B memberi CIDB kuasa penguatkuasaan berkanun secara langsung termasuk Perintah Henti Kerja (SWO) serta-merta dan perintah perobohan atas kos kontraktor.
questions.ref: Akta 520 Section 34B — Safety of Buildings & Works

questions.q_en: What is the maximum penalty under Section 34B/34C of Act 520 if a contractor fails to comply with a CIDB safety directive?
questions.q_bm: Apakah penalti maksimum di bawah Seksyen 34B/34C Akta 520 sekiranya kontraktor gagal mematuhi arahan keselamatan CIDB?
options_en: Fine up to RM500,000 plus an additional fine up to RM10,000 per day for continuing offences
Fine of RM5,000 only
Fine of RM25,000 with no daily penalty
Suspension for 24 hours only
options_bm: Denda sehingga RM500,000 ditambah denda tambahan sehingga RM10,000 sehari bagi kesalahan berterusan
Denda RM5,000 sahaja
Denda RM25,000 tanpa penalti harian
Penggantungan selama 24 jam sahaja
questions.exp_en: Non-compliance with CIDB safety directives attracts up to RM500,000 fine and RM10,000/day continuing penalty.
questions.exp_bm: Ketidakpatuhan terhadap arahan keselamatan CIDB boleh dikenakan denda sehingga RM500,000 dan penalti berterusan RM10,000 sehari.
questions.ref: Akta 520 Section 34C — Breach of Safety Directive

questions.q_en: Under Section 34C of CIDB Act 520, what is the penalty if a contractor's breach of safety duty results in DEATH?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 34C Akta CIDB 520, apakah penalti sekiranya pelanggaran kewajipan keselamatan oleh kontraktor mengakibatkan KEMATIAN?
options_en: Fine not exceeding RM500,000 OR imprisonment for a term not exceeding 2 years, or BOTH
Fine of RM10,000 only
Community service for 1 week
Revocation of Green Card only
options_bm: Denda tidak melebihi RM500,000 ATAU penjara bagi tempoh tidak melebihi 2 tahun, atau KEDUA-DUANYA
Denda RM10,000 sahaja
Khidmat masyarakat selama 1 minggu
Pembatalan Kad Hijau sahaja
questions.exp_en: Fatal breaches carry criminal liability up to RM500,000 fine, 2 years imprisonment, or both—on top of OSHA 1994 penalties.
questions.exp_bm: Pelanggaran yang menyebabkan kematian membawa liabiliti jenayah sehingga denda RM500,000, penjara 2 tahun, atau kedua-duanya—di samping penalti OSHA 1994.

questions.q_en: Does the contractor's statutory duty under Section 34A of Act 520 to ensure building safety end immediately upon Practical Completion?
questions.q_bm: Adakah kewajipan berkanun kontraktor di bawah Seksyen 34A Akta 520 untuk memastikan keselamatan bangunan tamat serta-merta selepas Siap Praktikal?
options_en: No — the statutory duty applies BOTH during construction AND after construction works are completed
Yes — all legal liability ends the second keys are handed over
Only during the first 30 days after piling
Only if the building has more than 20 storeys
options_bm: Tidak — kewajipan berkanun ini terpakai SEMASA pembinaan DAN SELEPAS kerja pembinaan siap
Ya — semua liabiliti undang-undang tamat sebaik sahaja kunci diserahkan

Hanya jika bangunan melebihi 20 tingkat

questions.ref: Akta 520 Section 34A — Duty During and Post Construction

questions.q_en: What action must a QA/QC Manager take at the site gate if a lorry delivers 30 tonnes of high-tensile reinforcement bars WITHOUT a valid CIDB PPS certificate?
questions.q_bm: Apakah tindakan yang mesti diambil oleh Pengurus QA/QC di pintu tapak sekiranya lori menghantar 30 tan bar tetulang keluli TANPA sijil PPS CIDB yang sah?
options_en: Reject the delivery immediately (or quarantine and prohibit installation) until valid PPS and mill certificates are verified
Allow workers to install the bars immediately and check certificates next month
Paint the bars to hide missing markings
Accept the bars at a 5% price discount
options_bm: Tolak penghantaran serta-merta (atau kuarantin dan larang pemasangan) sehingga sijil PPS dan sijil kilang yang sah disahkan
Benarkan pekerja memasang bar serta-merta dan semak sijil bulan depan
Cat bar tersebut untuk menyembunyikan tanda yang tiada
Terima bar tersebut dengan diskaun harga 5%
questions.exp_en: Using uncertified Fourth Schedule steel violates Act 520 Section 33C and compromises structural safety; uncertified batches must never enter permanent works.
questions.exp_bm: Menggunakan keluli Jadual Keempat tanpa sijil melanggar Seksyen 33C Akta 520 dan menjejaskan keselamatan struktur; kelompok tanpa sijil tidak boleh digunakan.

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian standards body works alongside CIDB to test and certify construction materials for PPS issuance?
questions.q_bm: Badan piawaian Malaysia manakah yang bekerjasama dengan CIDB untuk menguji dan memperakui bahan binaan bagi pengeluaran PPS?
options_en: SIRIM QAS International (and accredited ISO/IEC 17025 laboratories)
Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM)
Suruhanjaya Sekuriti Malaysia (SC)
Jabatan Imigresen Malaysia
options_bm: SIRIM QAS International (dan makmal bertauliah ISO/IEC 17025)
Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM)

Jabatan Imigresen Malaysia

questions.q_en: Under Section 70 of the Street, Drainage and Building Act 1974 (Act 133), what is the legal consequence of commencing building erection on site WITHOUT written Building Plan approval from the Local Authority?

options_en: It is a statutory offence subject to immediate Stop-Work Orders, heavy fines, and mandatory demolition of unauthorized structures
It is permitted as long as the developer owns the land
It is allowed for the first 3 storeys only
Only a RM50 administrative fee applies
options_bm: Ia adalah kesalahan berkanun yang tertakluk kepada Perintah Henti Kerja serta-merta, denda berat, dan perobohan wajib struktur tanpa kebenaran
Ia dibenarkan selagi pemaju memiliki tanah tersebut
Ia dibenarkan bagi 3 tingkat pertama sahaja
Hanya yuran pentadbiran RM50 dikenakan
questions.exp_en: Section 70 of Act 133 strictly prohibits commencing building works without written approval of plans and specifications by the Local Authority.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 70 Akta 133 melarang keras permulaan kerja bangunan tanpa kelulusan bertulis pelan dan spesifikasi oleh Pihak Berkuasa Tempatan.

questions.q_en: Which planning legislation governs Development Order (Kebenaran Merancang) applications specifically within Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur (such as Setiawangsa)?
questions.q_bm: Perundangan perancangan manakah yang mengawal selia permohonan Kebenaran Merancang (Development Order) secara khusus di Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur (seperti Setiawangsa)?
options_en: Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 (Act 267) (alongside Town and Country Planning Act 1976 principles)
Sarawak Land Code
Sabah Town and Country Planning Ordinance
Merchant Shipping Ordinance 1952
options_bm: Akta (Perancangan) Wilayah Persekutuan 1982 (Akta 267) (sejajar dengan prinsip Akta Perancangan Bandar dan Desa 1976)
Kanun Tanah Sarawak
Ordinan Perancangan Bandar dan Desa Sabah
Ordinan Perkapalan Saudagar 1952
questions.exp_en: While Act 172 applies across Peninsular states, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur is specifically governed by the Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 (Act 267) administered by DBKL.
questions.exp_bm: Walaupun Akta 172 terpakai di negeri-negeri Semenanjung, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur dikawal khusus oleh Akta (Perancangan) Wilayah Persekutuan 1982 (Akta 267) di bawah DBKL.

questions.q_en: What is the primary function of the Local Authority's One Stop Centre (OSC 3.0 Plus) in Malaysian building development?
questions.q_bm: Apakah fungsi utama Pusat Setempat (OSC 3.0 Plus) Pihak Berkuasa Tempatan dalam pembangunan bangunan di Malaysia?
options_en: To coordinate simultaneous or staged submission, technical agency review, and approval of Planning (DO), Building, Earthworks, Road & Drainage, and Landscape plans
To supply ready-mix concrete to private contractors
To recruit foreign construction workers
To arbitrate commercial payment disputes
options_bm: Untuk menyelaras penyerahan serentak atau berperingkat, semakan agensi teknikal, dan kelulusan pelan DO, Bangunan, Kerja Tanah, Jalan & Parit, serta Landskap
Untuk membekalkan konkrit siap bancuh kepada kontraktor swasta
Untuk merekrut pekerja binaan asing
Untuk menimbang tara pertikaian bayaran komersial
questions.exp_en: OSC 3.0 Plus acts as the single secretariat routing development proposals to internal departments and external technical agencies (Bomba, TNB, IWK, Air Selangor, JPS).
questions.exp_bm: OSC 3.0 Plus bertindak sebagai urus setia tunggal yang mengagihkan cadangan pemajuan kepada jabatan dalaman dan agensi teknikal luar (Bomba, TNB, IWK, Air Selangor, JPS).
questions.ref: KPKT Manual OSC 3.0 Plus & CCPM M01/M07

questions.q_en: Under the Uniform Building By-Laws (UBBL) 1984 (By-Law 25), which form certifies that a completed building is safe and fit for occupation?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Undang-Undang Kecil Bangunan Seragam (UBBL) 1984 (Undang-Undang Kecil 25), borang manakah yang memperakui bahawa bangunan yang siap adalah selamat dan layak untuk diduduki?
options_en: Borang F — Certificate of Completion and Compliance (CCC)
Borang G1 — Earthworks Stage Certification
Form CIDB L1/96
DOSH Form JKJ 103
options_bm: Borang F — Perakuan Siap dan Pematuhan (CCC)
Borang G1 — Perakuan Berperingkat Kerja-Kerja Tanah
Borang CIDB L1/96
Borang DOSH JKJ 103
questions.exp_en: Borang F (CCC) is issued by the Principal Submitting Person (PSP) only after all 21 stage forms (Borang G1–G21) and statutory agency clearances are completed.
questions.exp_bm: Borang F (CCC) dikeluarkan oleh Orang Utama Yang Mengemukakan (PSP) hanya selepas kesemua 21 borang berperingkat (Borang G1–G21) dan pelepasan agensi berkanun selesai.

questions.q_en: How many progressive stage-certification forms (Borang G) must be signed off across construction stages before the PSP can issue Borang F (CCC)?
questions.q_bm: Berapakah bilangan borang perakuan berperingkat (Borang G) yang mesti ditandatangani merentasi peringkat pembinaan sebelum PSP boleh mengeluarkan Borang F (CCC)?
options_en: 21 forms (Borang G1 to Borang G21)
5 forms (Borang G1 to Borang G5)
10 forms (Borang G1 to Borang G10)
50 forms (Borang G1 to Borang G50)
options_bm: 21 borang (Borang G1 hingga Borang G21)
5 borang (Borang G1 hingga Borang G5)
10 borang (Borang G1 hingga Borang G10)
50 borang (Borang G1 hingga Borang G50)
questions.exp_en: UBBL 1984 specifies 21 progressive stage certifications (G1 Earthworks, G2 Setting Out, G3 Foundations, G4 Structural, G8/G9 Fire, G11 Lifts, G17 STP, etc.).
questions.exp_bm: UBBL 1984 menetapkan 21 perakuan berperingkat (G1 Kerja Tanah, G2 Pemancangan Tanda, G3 Asas Tapak, G4 Struktur, G8/G9 Bomba, G11 Lif, G17 Loji Kumbahan, dll.).

questions.q_en: In UBBL 1984 stage certifications, what specific construction stage is certified under Borang G1 and Borang G3 respectively?
questions.q_bm: Dalam perakuan berperingkat UBBL 1984, peringkat pembinaan khusus manakah yang diperakui di bawah Borang G1 dan Borang G3 masing-masing?
options_en: G1: Earthworks (Kerja-kerja Tanah); G3: Foundations (Asas Tapak)
G1: Roofing; G3: Painting
G1: Lifts & Escalators; G3: Landscaping
G1: Street Lighting; G3: Sewerage
options_bm: G1: Kerja-kerja Tanah; G3: Asas Tapak
G1: Bumbung; G3: Mengecat
G1: Lif & Eskalator; G3: Landskap
G1: Lampu Jalan; G3: Pembetungan
questions.exp_en: Borang G1 covers Earthworks, Borang G2 covers Setting Out (Pemancangan Tanda), and Borang G3 covers Foundations (Asas Tapak).
questions.exp_bm: Borang G1 meliputi Kerja-kerja Tanah, Borang G2 meliputi Pemancangan Tanda, dan Borang G3 meliputi Asas Tapak.

questions.q_en: Who is required to co-sign Borang G stage certifications alongside the Submitting Person (Architect/Engineer)?
questions.q_bm: Siapakah yang dikehendaki menandatangani bersama perakuan berperingkat Borang G di samping Orang Yang Mengemukakan (Arkitek/Jurutera)?
options_en: The CIDB-registered Contractor (and Licensed Land Surveyor for G2 Setting Out)
The bank branch manager
The retail mall marketing manager
The local resident association chairman
options_bm: Kontraktor berdaftar CIDB (serta Juruukur Tanah Berlesen bagi G2 Pemancangan Tanda)
Pengurus cawangan bank
Pengurus pemasaran pusat beli-belah
Pengerusi persatuan penduduk tempatan
questions.exp_en: Both the CIDB-registered contractor and the Submitting Person (plus Licensed Land Surveyor on G2) sign Borang G to accept joint statutory accountability.
questions.exp_bm: Kedua-dua kontraktor berdaftar CIDB dan Orang Yang Mengemukakan (serta Juruukur Tanah Berlesen pada G2) menandatangani Borang G bagi memikul akauntabiliti berkanun bersama.

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian statute governs strata subdivision of commercial buildings or parcels into individual accessory/retail parcels?
questions.q_bm: Statut Malaysia manakah yang mengawal selia pecah bahagi strata bangunan komersial atau petak kepada petak individu/aksesori?

Land Acquisition Act 1960 (Act 486)
Fire Services Act 1988 (Act 341)
Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
options_bm: Akta Hakmilik Strata 1985 (Akta 318) (dan Akta Pengurusan Strata 2013, Akta 757)
Akta Pengambilan Tanah 1960 (Akta 486)
Akta Perkhidmatan Bomba 1988 (Akta 341)
Akta Kerja 1955 (Akta 265)
questions.exp_en: Act 318 governs strata title issuance while Act 757 governs post-handover building maintenance and Joint Management Body (JMB) / Management Corporation (MC) operations.
questions.exp_bm: Akta 318 mengawal selia pengeluaran hakmilik strata manakala Akta 757 mengawal selia penyenggaraan bangunan selepas serahan serta JMB / MC.

questions.q_en: Under the National Land Code 1965 (Act 56), what must a developer verify before building a shopping centre on land previously zoned/titled for agriculture or residential use?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Kanun Tanah Negara 1965 (Akta 56), apakah yang mesti disahkan oleh pemaju sebelum membina pusat beli-belah di atas tanah yang sebelum ini berstatus pertanian atau kediaman?
options_en: Conversion of land category/use to 'Building (Commercial)' and compliance with express conditions (Sections 124 / 204D)
Nothing — land titles never restrict building types
Only verbal permission from neighbours
Only a signboard permit
options_bm: Penukaran kategori/kegunaan tanah kepada 'Bangunan (Komersial)' dan pematuhan syarat nyata (Seksyen 124 / 204D)
Tiada apa-apa — geran tanah tidak pernah mengehadkan jenis bangunan
Hanya kebenaran lisan daripada jiran
Hanya permit papan tanda
questions.exp_en: Land category conversion and commercial zoning alignment under the National Land Code 1965 and Local Plan are prerequisites for Development Order approval.
questions.exp_bm: Penukaran kategori tanah dan penjajaran zon komersial di bawah Kanun Tanah Negara 1965 serta Pelan Tempatan adalah prasyarat kelulusan Kebenaran Merancang.

questions.q_en: What is a 'Letter of No Objection' (Surat Tiada Halangan) obtained during pre-consultation with technical agencies (TNB, IWK, Air Selangor, JPS)?
questions.q_bm: Apakah 'Surat Tiada Halangan' yang diperoleh semasa pra-rundingan dengan agensi teknikal (TNB, IWK, Air Selangor, JPS)?
options_en: Preliminary technical clearance confirming utility capacity, connection points, and reserve requirements before formal OSC submission
The final Certificate of Completion and Compliance
A waiver exempting the contractor from paying utility connection charges
An insurance policy covering crane collapse
options_bm: Pelepasan teknikal awal yang mengesahkan kapasiti utiliti, titik sambungan, dan keperluan rizab sebelum penyerahan rasmi OSC
Perakuan Siap dan Pematuhan (CCC) akhir
Pengecualian yang membebaskan kontraktor daripada membayar caj sambungan utiliti
Polisi insurans yang melindungi keruntuhan kren
questions.exp_en: Securing Letters of No Objection early prevents major layout redesigns when plans are circulated through DBKL OSC 3.0 Plus.
questions.exp_bm: Mendapatkan Surat Tiada Halangan lebih awal mengelakkan reka bentuk semula susun atur besar-besaran apabila pelan diedarkan melalui DBKL OSC 3.0 Plus.

questions.q_en: Under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 1994 (Act 514), which fundamental legal principle governs safety duties at a construction workplace?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Akta Keselamatan dan Kesihatan Pekerjaan 1994 (Akta 514), prinsip perundangan asas manakah yang mengawal selia kewajipan keselamatan di tempat kerja pembinaan?
options_en: Self-regulation: responsibility to ensure safety lies with those who create the risks (employers/contractors) and those who work with them
Only DOSH inspectors are responsible for site safety
Workers bear 100% responsibility and employers have zero duty
Safety rules only apply to government projects
options_bm: Peraturan kendiri (Self-regulation): tanggungjawab memastikan keselamatan terletak pada pihak yang mewujudkan risiko (majikan/kontraktor) dan pekerja
Hanya pemeriksa DOSH bertanggungjawab ke atas keselamatan tapak
Pekerja menanggung 100% tanggungjawab dan majikan tiada kewajipan
Peraturan keselamatan hanya terpakai kepada projek kerajaan
questions.exp_en: OSHA 1994 is built on the Robens self-regulation principle requiring employers, principals, designers, and employees to proactively manage workplace hazards.
questions.exp_bm: OSHA 1994 dibina atas prinsip peraturan kendiri Robens yang mewajibkan majikan, prinsipal, pereka bentuk, dan pekerja mengurus bahaya tempat kerja secara proaktif.

questions.q_en: Under the Factories and Machinery (Building Operations and Works of Engineering Construction) (Safety) Regulations 1986 (BOWEC), at least how many days before commencing site operations must the contractor notify DOSH (Form JKJ 103)?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Peraturan-Peraturan Kilang dan Jentera (Kendalian Bangunan dan Kerja-Kerja Kejuruteraan Binaan) (Keselamatan) 1986 (BOWEC), sekurang-kurangnya berapa hari sebelum memulakan operasi tapak kontraktor mesti memaklumkan DOSH (Borang JKJ 103)?
options_en: At least 7 days before commencing operations (for works lasting >6 weeks)
Within 6 months after completing the roof
1 hour before concrete pouring
Notification is never required
options_bm: Sekurang-kurangnya 7 hari sebelum memulakan operasi (bagi kerja melebihi 6 minggu)
Dalam tempoh 6 bulan selepas menyiapkan bumbung
1 jam sebelum penuangan konkrit
Pemakluman tidak pernah diperlukan
questions.exp_en: BOWEC / OSHA construction regulations require written notification to DOSH (Form JKJ 103) at least 7 days prior to commencing construction operations.
questions.exp_bm: Peraturan pembinaan BOWEC / OSHA mewajibkan pemakluman bertulis kepada DOSH (Borang JKJ 103) sekurang-kurangnya 7 hari sebelum memulakan operasi pembinaan.

questions.q_en: Under the Occupational Safety and Health (Safety and Health Officer) Order 1997, what is the contract value threshold above which a construction project MUST employ a full-time DOSH-registered Safety and Health Officer (SHO)?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Perintah Keselamatan dan Kesihatan Pekerjaan (Pegawai Keselamatan dan Kesihatan) 1997, berapakah nilai ambang kontrak di mana projek pembinaan WAJIB menggaji Pegawai Keselamatan dan Kesihatan (SHO) sepenuh masa yang berdaftar dengan DOSH?
options_en: Total contract price exceeding RM20,000,000.00
Total contract price exceeding RM500,000.00
Total contract price exceeding RM5,000,000.00
Only projects exceeding RM500,000,000.00
options_bm: Jumlah harga kontrak melebihi RM20,000,000.00
Jumlah harga kontrak melebihi RM500,000.00
Jumlah harga kontrak melebihi RM5,000,000.00
Hanya projek melebihi RM500,000,000.00
questions.exp_en: Any building operation or engineering construction work exceeding RM20 million (such as the RM180.5M Setiawangsa Mall) legally requires a full-time registered SHO.
questions.exp_bm: Mana-mana kendalian bangunan atau kerja kejuruteraan binaan melebihi RM20 juta (seperti Pusat Beli-Belah Setiawangsa RM180.5J) wajib menggaji SHO berdaftar sepenuh masa.

questions.q_en: Under Section 30 of OSHA 1994, when is an employer legally required to establish a formal Safety and Health Committee at the workplace?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 30 OSHA 1994, bilakah majikan dikehendaki secara sah menubuhkan Jawatankuasa Keselamatan dan Kesihatan rasmi di tempat kerja?
options_en: When there are 40 or more persons employed at the workplace (or as directed by the Director General of DOSH)
Only when there are more than 5,000 workers
Only after a fatal accident happens
Never on commercial projects
options_bm: Apabila terdapat 40 orang atau lebih yang digajikan di tempat kerja (atau sebagaimana diarahkan oleh Ketua Pengarah DOSH)
Hanya apabila terdapat lebih daripada 5,000 pekerja
Hanya selepas kemalangan maut berlaku
Tidak pernah bagi projek komersial
questions.exp_en: Workplaces with 40 or more personnel must form a joint management-worker Safety and Health Committee meeting at least once every 3 months (monthly best practice on sites).
questions.exp_bm: Tempat kerja yang mempunyai 40 orang atau lebih wajib menubuhkan Jawatankuasa Keselamatan dan Kesihatan bersama yang bermesyuarat sekurang-kurangnya 3 bulan sekali (bulanan di tapak).

questions.q_en: What is the role of 'OSHCIM 2017' (Guidelines on Occupational Safety and Health in Construction Industry Management) issued by DOSH Malaysia?
questions.q_bm: Apakah peranan 'OSHCIM 2017' (Garis Panduan Keselamatan dan Kesihatan Pekerjaan dalam Pengurusan Industri Pembinaan) yang dikeluarkan oleh DOSH Malaysia?
options_en: To integrate safety and health risk management early into pre-construction planning and design across Clients, Designers, and Contractors
To set retail rental rates for shopping malls
To replace CIDB contractor registration
To govern customs import duties
options_bm: Untuk mengintegrasikan pengurusan risiko keselamatan dan kesihatan lebih awal ke dalam perancangan pra-pembinaan dan reka bentuk merentasi Klien, Pereka Bentuk, dan Kontraktor
Untuk menetapkan kadar sewa runcit pusat beli-belah
Untuk menggantikan pendaftaran kontraktor CIDB
Untuk mengawal selia duti import kastam

questions.exp_bm: OSHCIM (berteraskan prinsip CDM) meletakkan kewajipan pencegahan melalui reka bentuk ke atas Klien dan Pereka Bentuk di samping Kontraktor.

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian Act governs fire safety design approvals, fire-fighting systems, and Fire Certificate requirements for designated commercial premises like shopping centres?

questions.q_en: Before operating a tower crane, passenger hoist, or air compressor on a Malaysian construction site, what valid statutory certificate must be obtained from DOSH?
questions.q_bm: Sebelum mengendalikan kren menara, lif penumpang tapak (hoist), atau pemampat udara di tapak bina Malaysia, apakah perakuan berkanun sah yang mesti diperoleh daripada DOSH?

Permit Pelepasan Pembetungan IWK

questions.q_en: Under the Occupational Safety and Health (Amendment) Act 2022 (Act A1648), what happened to the maximum general penalty for employers breaching safety duties under Section 15–18?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Akta Keselamatan dan Kesihatan Pekerjaan (Pindaan) 2022 (Akta A1648), apakah perubahan kepada penalti maksimum am bagi majikan yang melanggar kewajipan keselamatan di bawah Seksyen 15–18?

questions.q_en: Which statutory social security scheme must cover all local and foreign construction workers employed in Malaysia?
questions.q_bm: Skim keselamatan sosial berkanun manakah yang mesti melindungi semua pekerja binaan tempatan dan asing yang digajikan di Malaysia?
options_en: SOCSO (PERKESO) under the Employees' Social Security Act 1969 (Act 4)
Only voluntary travel insurance
EPF only for foreign workers
No coverage is required for temporary site workers
options_bm: PERKESO (SOCSO) di bawah Akta Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja 1969 (Akta 4)
Hanya insurans perjalanan sukarela
KWSP sahaja bagi pekerja asing
Tiada perlindungan diperlukan bagi pekerja tapak sementara
questions.exp_en: All employees (including foreign workers since 2019) must be registered and contributed for under SOCSO/PERKESO for employment injury protection.
questions.exp_bm: Semua pekerja (termasuk pekerja asing sejak 2019) wajib didaftarkan dan dicarumkan di bawah PERKESO/SOCSO bagi perlindungan bencana pekerjaan.
questions.ref: Employees' Social Security Act 1969 & CCPM M01

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian Act governs environmental pollution control, Environmental Impact Assessments (Section 34A), Environmental Audits (Section 33A), and Scheduled Wastes?
questions.q_bm: Akta Malaysia manakah yang mengawal selia kawalan pencemaran alam sekitar, Penilaian Impak Alam Sekitar (Seksyen 34A), Audit Alam Sekitar (Seksyen 33A), dan Buangan Terjadual?
options_en: Environmental Quality Act 1974 (Act 127)
Electricity Supply Act 1990 (Act 447)
Strata Titles Act 1985 (Act 318)
Housing Development Act 1966 (Act 118)
options_bm: Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling 1974 (Akta 127)
Akta Bekalan Elektrik 1990 (Akta 447)
Akta Hakmilik Strata 1985 (Akta 318)
Akta Pemajuan Perumahan 1966 (Akta 118)
questions.exp_en: Act 127, administered by the Department of Environment (DOE / JAS), regulates air, water, noise, open burning (Sec 29A), and scheduled wastes.
questions.exp_bm: Akta 127 yang ditadbir oleh Jabatan Alam Sekitar (JAS / DOE) mengawal selia udara, air, bunyi bising, pembakaran terbuka (Sek 29A), dan buangan terjadual.

questions.q_en: Under Section 29A of the Environmental Quality Act 1974, what is the legal rule regarding open burning of timber formwork or clearing debris on a construction site?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 29A Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling 1974, apakah peraturan undang-undang mengenai pembakaran terbuka acuan kayu atau sisa pembersihan di tapak pembinaan?
options_en: Strictly prohibited — open burning on construction sites is an offence punishable by fine up to RM500,000 or imprisonment up to 5 years, or both
Allowed every Sunday afternoon
Allowed if the fire is smaller than 5 metres
Permitted without restriction during rainy days
options_bm: Dilarang keras — pembakaran terbuka di tapak pembinaan adalah kesalahan yang boleh didenda sehingga RM500,000 atau penjara sehingga 5 tahun, atau kedua-duanya
Dibenarkan setiap petang Ahad
Dibenarkan jika api lebih kecil daripada 5 meter
Dibenarkan tanpa sekatan pada hari hujan
questions.exp_en: Section 29A imposes strict zero-tolerance liability on landowners and occupiers/contractors for any open burning on construction sites.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 29A mengenakan liabiliti toleransi sifar yang ketat ke atas pemilik tanah dan penghuni/kontraktor bagi sebarang pembakaran terbuka di tapak bina.
questions.ref: EQA 1974 Section 29A — Prohibition on Open Burning

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian statute governs electrical installation licensing, competent Chargeman/Wireman requirements, and high-voltage supply safety (such as an 11kV mall substation)?
questions.q_bm: Statut Malaysia manakah yang mengawal selia pelesenan pemasangan elektrik, keperluan Penjaga Jentera (Chargeman)/Pendawai kompeten, dan keselamatan bekalan voltan tinggi (seperti pencawang 11kV pusat beli-belah)?
options_en: Electricity Supply Act 1990 (Act 447) (enforced by Suruhanjaya Tenaga)
Fire Services Act 1988 (Act 341)
Land Conservation Act 1960 (Act 385)
Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
options_bm: Akta Bekalan Elektrik 1990 (Akta 447) (dikuatkuasakan oleh Suruhanjaya Tenaga)
Akta Perkhidmatan Bomba 1988 (Akta 341)
Akta Pemuliharaan Tanah 1960 (Akta 385)
Akta Kerja 1955 (Akta 265)
questions.exp_en: Act 447 and the Electricity Regulations 1994 mandate that electrical installations and HV substations be designed, tested, and operated by ST-registered competent persons.
questions.exp_bm: Akta 447 dan Peraturan-Peraturan Elektrik 1994 mewajibkan pemasangan elektrik dan pencawang HV direka, diuji, dan dikendalikan oleh orang kompeten berdaftar ST.

questions.q_en: What is the primary objective of the Construction Industry Payment and Adjudication Act 2012 (CIPAA, Act 746)?
questions.q_bm: Apakah objektif utama Akta Pembayaran dan Adjudikasi Industri Pembinaan 2012 (CIPAA, Akta 746)?
options_en: To facilitate regular and timely payment in construction contracts, prohibit conditional 'pay-when-paid' clauses, and provide rapid statutory adjudication
To fix the price of cement and steel bars
To replace DBKL building plan approvals
To regulate foreign worker visas
options_bm: Untuk memudahkan pembayaran tetap dan tepat pada masanya dalam kontrak pembinaan, melarang klausa bersyarat 'pay-when-paid', dan menyediakan adjudikasi berkanun yang pantas
Untuk menetapkan harga simen dan bar keluli
Untuk menggantikan kelulusan pelan bangunan DBKL
Untuk mengawal selia visa pekerja asing
questions.exp_en: CIPAA 2012 protects cash flow across the construction supply chain by outlawing 'pay-when-paid' clauses (Section 35) and providing a 45-working-day adjudication remedy.
questions.exp_bm: CIPAA 2012 melindungi aliran tunai merentasi rantaian bekalan pembinaan dengan mengharamkan klausa 'pay-when-paid' (Seksyen 35) dan menyediakan remedi adjudikasi 45 hari bekerja.

questions.q_en: Under Section 35 of CIPAA 2012, what is the legal status of a subcontract clause stating 'The Main Contractor shall pay the Subcontractor only when paid by the Employer'?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 35 CIPAA 2012, apakah status perundangan klausa subkontrak yang menyatakan 'Kontraktor Utama hanya akan membayar Subkontraktor apabila dibayar oleh Majikan'?
options_en: Void and unenforceable
Fully valid and binding
Valid only for contracts above RM100 million
Valid if written in red ink
options_bm: Batal dan tidak boleh dikuatkuasakan (Void)
Sah sepenuhnya dan mengikat
Sah hanya bagi kontrak melebihi RM100 juta
Sah jika ditulis dengan dakwat merah
questions.exp_en: Section 35 of CIPAA 2012 renders all conditional payment provisions ('pay-when-paid' or 'pay-if-paid') in construction contracts void.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 35 CIPAA 2012 menjadikan semua peruntukan pembayaran bersyarat ('pay-when-paid' atau 'pay-if-paid') dalam kontrak pembinaan terbatal.
questions.ref: CIPAA 2012 Section 35 — Prohibition of Conditional Payment

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian Act sets minimum standards for worker accommodation (Centralised Labour Quarters / CLQ) and amenities provided to construction workers?
questions.q_bm: Akta Malaysia manakah yang menetapkan standard minimum bagi penginapan pekerja (Kuarters Pekerja Berpusat / CLQ) dan kemudahan yang disediakan kepada pekerja binaan?
options_en: Employees' Minimum Standards of Housing, Accommodations and Amenities Act 1990 (Act 446)
Street, Drainage and Building Act 1974 (Act 133)
Fire Services Act 1988 (Act 341)
Strata Titles Act 1985 (Act 318)
options_bm: Akta Standard Minimum Perumahan, Penginapan dan Kemudahan Pekerja 1990 (Akta 446)
Akta Jalan, Parit dan Bangunan 1974 (Akta 133)
Akta Perkhidmatan Bomba 1988 (Akta 341)
Akta Hakmilik Strata 1985 (Akta 318)
questions.exp_en: Act 446 (enforced by JTK / Department of Labour) requires a Certificate for Accommodation and strict space, sanitation, and safety standards for worker quarters.
questions.exp_bm: Akta 446 (dikuatkuasakan oleh JTK) mewajibkan Perakuan Penginapan serta standard ruang, sanitasi, dan keselamatan yang ketat bagi kuarters pekerja.

questions.q_en: Which Malaysian Act governs the registration and professional recognition of Engineering Technologists (Ts.) and Certified Technicians (Tc.) in the construction industry?
questions.q_bm: Akta Malaysia manakah yang mengawal selia pendaftaran dan pengiktirafan profesional Teknologis Kejuruteraan (Ts.) dan Juruteknik Bertauliah (Tc.) dalam industri pembinaan?
options_en: Technologists and Technicians Act 2015 (Act 768) (administered by MBOT)
Land Public Transport Act 2010 (Act 715)
Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
Environmental Quality Act 1974 (Act 127)
