Akta Pengangkutan Awam Darat 2010 (Akta 715)
Akta Kerja 1955 (Akta 265)
Akta Kualiti Alam Sekeliling 1974 (Akta 127)
questions.exp_en: Act 768 established the Malaysia Board of Technologists (MBOT) to accredit Graduate Technologists, Professional Technologists (Ts.), and Certified Technicians (Tc.).
questions.exp_bm: Akta 768 menubuhkan Lembaga Teknologis Malaysia (MBOT) untuk mengakreditasi Teknologis Siswazah, Teknologis Profesional (Ts.), dan Juruteknik Bertauliah (Tc.).

questions.q_en: Which legislation governs public transport interfaces, traffic impact approvals, and commercial vehicle haulage compliance in Peninsular Malaysia?
questions.q_bm: Perundangan manakah yang mengawal selia antara muka pengangkutan awam, kelulusan impak trafik, dan pematuhan pengangkutan kenderaan perdagangan di Semenanjung Malaysia?
options_en: Land Public Transport Act 2010 (Act 715) (and Road Transport Act 1987, Act 333)
Fire Services Act 1988 (Act 341)
Strata Titles Act 1985 (Act 318)
Housing Development Act 1966 (Act 118)
options_bm: Akta Pengangkutan Awam Darat 2010 (Akta 715) (dan Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987, Akta 333)
Akta Perkhidmatan Bomba 1988 (Akta 341)
Akta Hakmilik Strata 1985 (Akta 318)
Akta Pemajuan Perumahan 1966 (Akta 118)
questions.exp_en: Act 715 (enforced by APAD) and Road Transport Act 1987 (JPJ) regulate heavy haulage operator permits, overloading, and public transport integration.
questions.exp_bm: Akta 715 (dikuatkuasakan oleh APAD) dan Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987 (JPJ) mengawal selia permit pengendali kenderaan berat, muatan berlebihan, dan integrasi pengangkutan awam.

questions.q_en: Under the Employment Act 1955 (Act 265, as amended), what is the maximum normal working hours per week for employees in Malaysia before overtime rates apply?
questions.q_bm: Di bawah Akta Kerja 1955 (Akta 265, pindaan), berapakah had maksimum waktu kerja biasa seminggu bagi pekerja di Malaysia sebelum kadar kerja lebih masa (overtime) terpakai?
options_en: 45 hours per week
60 hours per week
72 hours per week
30 hours per week
options_bm: 45 jam seminggu
60 jam seminggu
72 jam seminggu
30 jam seminggu

questions.exp_bm: Akta Kerja (Pindaan) 2022 menurunkan had maksimum waktu kerja mingguan daripada 48 jam kepada 45 jam seminggu.

questions.q_en: Which regulatory body oversees sewerage infrastructure approvals (such as a shopping mall Sewage Treatment Plant — STP) in Peninsular Malaysia?
questions.q_bm: Badan kawal selia manakah yang menyelia kelulusan infrastruktur pembetungan (seperti Loji Rawatan Kumbahan — STP pusat beli-belah) di Semenanjung Malaysia?
options_en: Suruhanjaya Perkhidmatan Air Negara (SPAN) and Indah Water Konsortium (IWK) under Water Services Industry Act 2006 (Act 655)
Jabatan Laut Malaysia
Bank Negara Malaysia
Lembaga Getah Malaysia
options_bm: Suruhanjaya Perkhidmatan Air Negara (SPAN) dan Indah Water Konsortium (IWK) di bawah Akta Industri Perkhidmatan Air 2006 (Akta 655)
Jabatan Laut Malaysia
Bank Negara Malaysia
Lembaga Getah Malaysia
questions.exp_en: SPAN regulates water supply and sewerage services under Act 655, with IWK acting as the certifying agency for STP designs and Borang G17.
questions.exp_bm: SPAN mengawal selia perkhidmatan bekalan air dan pembetungan di bawah Akta 655, dengan IWK sebagai agensi perakuan bagi reka bentuk STP dan Borang G17.

questions.q_en: In the Setiawangsa Shopping Centre brief, Possession Date is 10/03/2021, Duration is 130 weeks, and Stated Completion is 05/09/2023. What did our baseline audit discover when calculating 10/03/2021 + 130 weeks (910 days)?
questions.q_bm: Dalam ringkasan kes Pusat Beli-Belah Setiawangsa, Tarikh Milik Tapak ialah 10/03/2021, Tempoh ialah 130 minggu, dan Tarikh Siap Dinyatakan ialah 05/09/2023. Apakah yang ditemui dalam audit garis dasar apabila mengira 10/03/2021 + 130 minggu (910 hari)?
options_en: Adding 910 calendar days gives 06/09/2023—a 1-day contractual discrepancy that must be formally clarified without silently altering the contract text
The contract is actually 200 weeks long
Completion falls in December 2024
There is a 60-day error
options_bm: Penambahan 910 hari kalendar menghasilkan 06/09/2023—percanggahan kontrak 1 hari yang mesti dijelaskan secara rasmi tanpa meminda teks kontrak secara senyap
Kontrak sebenarnya berdurasi 200 minggu
Tarikh siap jatuh pada Disember 2024
Terdapat ralat selama 60 hari
questions.exp_en: 130 weeks × 7 days = 910 days from 10 March 2021 lands on 6 September 2023 (or 5 Sept if inclusive counting applies). Clarifying this upfront prevents LAD disputes.
questions.exp_bm: 130 minggu × 7 hari = 910 hari dari 10 Mac 2021 jatuh pada 6 September 2023 (atau 5 Sept jika kiraan inklusif). Penjelasan awal mengelakkan pertikaian LAD.

questions.q_en: If the Setiawangsa Shopping Centre suffers a 10-calendar-day critical delay caused by the contractor's late CIDB material compliance, what is the direct LAD exposure at RM10,500.00/day?
questions.q_bm: Sekiranya Pusat Beli-Belah Setiawangsa mengalami kelewatan kritikal 10 hari kalendar akibat kelewatan kontraktor mematuhi pensijilan bahan CIDB, berapakah pendedahan LAD langsung pada kadar RM10,500.00/hari?
questions.exp_en: Direct LAD = 10 days × RM10,500.00/day = RM105,000.00 (excluding idle site preliminaries).
questions.exp_bm: LAD Langsung = 10 hari × RM10,500.00/hari = RM105,000.00 (tidak termasuk kos preliminari tapak yang terbiar).

questions.q_en: On the 468,000 sq ft Setiawangsa site, what is the approximate land area in square metres and acres?

questions.q_en: Which set of eight (8) physical construction components is explicitly specified in Section B of the CIDB Setiawangsa case study?
questions.q_bm: Set lapan (8) komponen pembinaan fizikal manakah yang dinyatakan secara khusus dalam Bahagian B kajian kes Setiawangsa CIDB?

200 Terrace Houses, 1 Mosque, 1 School, and 1 Football Stadium
50-Storey Office Tower, Helipad, and Monorail Station
Oil Refinery, Jetty, and Petrochemical Tank Farm

200 Rumah Teres, 1 Masjid, 1 Sekolah, dan 1 Stadium Bola Sepak
Menara Pejabat 50 Tingkat, Helipad, dan Stesen Monorel

questions.q_en: When preparing the Setiawangsa PMP, why must the CPM keep the project's 24-month Defects Liability Period (DLP) distinct from the 130-week Construction Period?
questions.q_bm: Semasa menyediakan PMP Setiawangsa, mengapakah CPM mesti membezakan Tempoh Tanggungan Kecacatan (DLP) 24 bulan daripada Tempoh Pembinaan 130 minggu?
options_en: Because the 130-week period ends at Practical Completion (CPC), whereas the 24-month DLP runs post-PC to govern defect rectification and second-half retention release
Because DLP happens before piling begins
Because LAD applies during the 24-month DLP
Because no defects are allowed to be reported during DLP
options_bm: Kerana tempoh 130 minggu tamat pada Siap Praktikal (CPC), manakala DLP 24 bulan bermula selepas PC untuk mengawal pembaikan kecacatan dan pelepasan separuh kedua wang tahanan
Kerana DLP berlaku sebelum kerja cerucuk bermula
Kerana LAD dikenakan semasa DLP 24 bulan
Kerana tiada kecacatan dibenarkan dilaporkan semasa DLP
questions.exp_en: Practical Completion triggers CCC/occupation and releases the first 50% retention; the 24-month DLP follows PC and concludes with CMGD and final retention release.
questions.exp_bm: Siap Praktikal mencetuskan CCC/pendudukan dan melepaskan 50% wang tahanan pertama; DLP 24 bulan menyusul selepas PC dan berakhir dengan CMGD serta pelepasan baki wang tahanan.

questions.q_en: In a Kuala Lumpur commercial development under DBKL, if a D&B contractor begins bulk earthworks and foundation piling before DBKL approves the Earthworks Plan and Building Plan, which statute is breached?
questions.q_bm: Dalam pembangunan komersial Kuala Lumpur di bawah DBKL, jika kontraktor D&B memulakan kerja tanah pukal dan cerucuk asas sebelum DBKL meluluskan Pelan Kerja Tanah dan Pelan Bangunan, statut manakah yang dilanggar?
options_en: Street, Drainage and Building Act 1974 (Act 133, Section 70 & 70A) and Federal Territory (Planning) Act 1982 (Act 267)
CIPAA 2012 (Act 746)
Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
Strata Titles Act 1985 (Act 318)
options_bm: Akta Jalan, Parit dan Bangunan 1974 (Akta 133, Seksyen 70 & 70A) dan Akta (Perancangan) Wilayah Persekutuan 1982 (Akta 267)
CIPAA 2012 (Akta 746)
Akta Kerja 1955 (Akta 265)
Akta Hakmilik Strata 1985 (Akta 318)
questions.exp_en: Section 70A of Act 133 specifically governs Earthworks Plan approval, while Section 70 governs Building Plan approval prior to site execution.
questions.exp_bm: Seksyen 70A Akta 133 mengawal selia kelulusan Pelan Kerja Tanah secara khusus, manakala Seksyen 70 mengawal selia kelulusan Pelan Bangunan sebelum pelaksanaan tapak.

questions.q_en: Why does the CIDB PA rubric award higher marks when a candidate integrates 'Program Outcomes (PO)' and 'Learning Outcomes (LO)' across Modules 01–16?
questions.q_bm: Mengapakah rubrik PA CIDB memberikan markah lebih tinggi apabila calon mengintegrasikan 'Hasil Program (PO)' dan 'Hasil Pembelajaran (LO)' merentasi Modul 01–16?
options_en: It proves the candidate's technical solutions directly satisfy Level 6 CSQF competency standards rather than merely copying generic templates
It allows the candidate to skip Modules 10 to 16
It reduces the word count requirement to 500 words
It exempts the report from binding
options_bm: Ia membuktikan penyelesaian teknikal calon memenuhi secara langsung standard kompetensi CSQF Tahap 6 dan bukannya sekadar menyalin templat umum
Ia membolehkan calon melangkau Modul 10 hingga 16
Ia mengurangkan syarat jumlah perkataan kepada 500 patah perkataan
Ia mengecualikan laporan daripada dijilid
questions.exp_en: Mapping POs and LOs to concrete project controls demonstrates authentic Level 6 mastery and synthesis.
questions.exp_bm: Memetakan PO dan LO kepada kawalan projek yang konkrit membuktikan penguasaan dan sintesis Tahap 6 yang tulen.
questions.ref: CIDB PA Assessment Criteria — PO & LO Attainment

questions.q_en: If Perintis Development Berhad appoints an internal D&B project team that lacks a valid CIDB Grade G7 registration (holding only Grade G5), what must the CPM advise immediately?
questions.q_bm: Jika Perintis Development Berhad melantik pasukan projek D&B dalaman yang tidak mempunyai pendaftaran CIDB Gred G7 yang sah (hanya memegang Gred G5), apakah nasihat segera CPM?
options_en: Halt contract execution under that entity immediately and ensure a valid CIDB Grade G7 (Categories B, CE, ME) entity is registered/appointed before site work
Proceed anyway because RM180.5M is close enough to RM5M
Split the 7-storey mall into 36 separate G5 contracts to bypass CIDB rules
Ignore CIDB registration until Practical Completion
options_bm: Hentikan pelaksanaan kontrak di bawah entiti tersebut serta-merta dan pastikan entiti CIDB Gred G7 (Kategori B, CE, ME) yang sah didaftarkan/dilantik sebelum kerja tapak
Teruskan sahaja kerana RM180.5J cukup hampir dengan RM5J
Pecahkan pusat beli-belah 7 tingkat kepada 36 kontrak G5 berasingan untuk memintas peraturan CIDB
Abaikan pendaftaran CIDB sehingga Siap Praktikal
questions.exp_en: Splitting contracts to evade registration limits or contracting above grade limit is illegal under Act 520 Section 25/29.
questions.exp_bm: Memecahkan kontrak untuk mengelak had pendaftaran atau berkontrak melebihi had gred adalah menyalahi undang-undang di bawah Seksyen 25/29 Akta 520.

questions.q_en: In a 50-to-80-page CIDB PA report, why should a candidate NEVER fabricate borehole logs, clause numbers, or site survey coordinates when none are provided in the question?
questions.q_bm: Dalam laporan PA CIDB sepanjang 50 hingga 80 muka surat, mengapakah calon TIDAK PERNAH boleh mereka-reka log lubang jara (borehole), nombor klausa, atau koordinat ukur tapak apabila tiada dalam soalan?
options_en: Because professional integrity requires distinguishing verified case-study facts from explicitly labelled planning assumptions pending validation
Because boreholes are never used in shopping centres
Because clause numbers do not exist in Malaysian contracts
Because assessors only read the cover page
options_bm: Kerana integriti profesional menuntut pembezaan jelas antara fakta kajian kes yang disahkan dengan andaian perancangan yang dilabel secara eksplisit sementara menunggu pengesahan
Kerana lubang jara tidak pernah digunakan dalam pusat beli-belah
Kerana nombor klausa tidak wujud dalam kontrak Malaysia
Kerana penilai hanya membaca muka hadapan sahaja
questions.exp_en: Assessors penalize fabricated claims presented as facts, whereas explicitly labelled illustrative assumptions show genuine project management discipline.
questions.exp_bm: Penilai menolak dakwaan rekaan yang dipersembahkan sebagai fakta, manakala andaian ilustrasi yang dilabel secara eksplisit menunjukkan disiplin pengurusan projek yang tulen.

questions.q_en: Which combination of statutory clearances is mandatory before the PSP can issue Borang F (CCC) for the Setiawangsa Shopping Centre?
questions.q_bm: Gabungan pelepasan berkanun manakah yang wajib sebelum PSP boleh mengeluarkan Borang F (CCC) bagi Pusat Beli-Belah Setiawangsa?
options_en: All 21 Borang G1–G21 forms signed, Bomba Fire Clearance, DOSH PMA for lifts/escalators, TNB energization, Air Selangor water supply, and IWK STP clearance
Only a signed receipt from the concrete supplier
Only a marketing brochure for the 200 retail stores
Only the initial tender advertisement

Hanya resit bertandatangan daripada pembekal konkrit
Hanya risalah pemasaran bagi 200 stor jualan
Hanya iklan tender awal

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: During a surprise joint audit at Week 38, CIDB enforcement officers find 12 foreign welders and 3 site supervisors working on structural steel without CIDB SKK accreditation cards. What is the immediate statutory exposure and CPM action?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Semasa audit mengejut pada Minggu ke-38, pegawai penguat kuasa CIDB mendapati 12 pengimpal asing dan 3 penyelia tapak bekerja pada struktur keluli tanpa kad akreditasi SKK CIDB. Apakah pendedahan berkanun segera dan tindakan CPM?
options_en: Fine up to RM5,000 per unaccredited person on both worker and employer under Sec 33A; immediately stand down unaccredited personnel, replace with SKK-certified crews, and audit all subcontractor trade registers
Hide the workers in the basement until officers leave
Tell CIDB officers that steel welding does not require accreditation
Deduct the fine from the client's contingency fund
options_bm: Denda sehingga RM5,000 bagi setiap individu tidak bertauliah ke atas pekerja dan majikan di bawah Sek 33A; hentikan tugas mereka serta-merta, gantikan dengan kru bertauliah SKK, dan audit semua daftar tred subkontraktor
Sembunyikan pekerja di ruang bawah tanah sehingga pegawai beredar
Beritahu pegawai CIDB bahawa kimpalan keluli tidak memerlukan akreditasi
Tolak denda tersebut daripada dana luar jangka klien
questions.exp_en: Under Act 520 Section 33A, both worker and employer face fines up to RM5,000 each, and uncertified structural welds risk structural failure and NCR rejection.
questions.exp_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 33A Akta 520, pekerja dan majikan berdepan denda sehingga RM5,000 setiap satu, dan kimpalan struktur tanpa tauliah berisiko gagal struktur dan ditolak NCR.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: Two months after contract award, you discover the commercial team forgot to submit Form CIDB L1/96 and pay the RM225,625.00 levy. What is the maximum statutory fine exposure if prosecuted, and what must you do immediately?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Dua bulan selepas penganugerahan kontrak, anda mendapati pasukan komersial terlupa menghantar Borang CIDB L1/96 dan membayar levi RM225,625.00. Apakah pendedahan denda berkanun maksimum jika didakwa, dan apakah tindakan segera anda?
options_en: Up to RM50,000 for late/non-declaration PLUS up to 4× levy (RM902,500) for non-payment; immediately lodge Form L1/96, settle the RM225,625 levy, and submit formal mitigation to CIDB
Wait until project completion in 2023 to declare
Declare the contract value as RM450,000 to avoid paying levy
Ignore it because Perintis is a public-listed company
options_bm: Sehingga RM50,000 bagi kelewatan/kegagalan pengisytiharan DITAMBAH sehingga 4× levi (RM902,500) bagi kegagalan bayaran; segera hantar Borang L1/96, jelaskan levi RM225,625, dan kemukakan rayuan mitigasi rasmi kepada CIDB
Tunggu sehingga projek siap pada 2023 untuk mengisytihar
Isytiharkan nilai kontrak sebagai RM450,000 untuk mengelak bayar levi
Abaikan kerana Perintis ialah syarikat tersenarai awam
questions.exp_en: Voluntary immediate declaration and full payment of the RM225,625 levy demonstrates good faith and mitigates prosecution risk under Section 34.
questions.exp_bm: Pengisytiharan segera secara sukarela dan pembayaran penuh levi RM225,625 menunjukkan niat baik dan mengurangkan risiko pendakwaan di bawah Seksyen 34.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: A tower crane luffing wire snaps during lifting at Setiawangsa, injuring a rigger. Both DOSH and CIDB issue immediate Stop-Work Orders (SWO). Which statutory conditions must be satisfied before lifting operations can legally resume?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Kabel kren menara putus semasa kerja mengangkat di Setiawangsa, mencederakan seorang juruikat (rigger). Kedua-dua DOSH dan CIDB mengeluarkan Perintah Henti Kerja (SWO) serta-merta. Syarat berkanun manakah yang mesti dipenuhi sebelum operasi mengangkat boleh disambung semula secara sah?
options_en: Root-cause incident investigation, replacement & load-testing of wire rope, re-inspection by DOSH (valid PMA) and CIDB, and formal written lifting of both SWOs
Resume lifting the next morning after a 5-minute toolbox talk
Only ask the crane operator to sign an indemnity letter
Continue lifting at night when inspectors are asleep
options_bm: Siasatan punca insiden, penggantian & ujian beban kabel, pemeriksaan semula oleh DOSH (PMA sah) dan CIDB, serta penarikan balik bertulis rasmi kedua-dua SWO
Sambung mengangkat keesokan pagi selepas taklimat toolbox 5 minit
Hanya minta pengendali kren menandatangani surat tanggung rugi
Teruskan kerja mengangkat pada waktu malam semasa pemeriksa tiada
questions.exp_en: Breaching a DOSH or CIDB Stop-Work Order carries severe criminal penalties (up to RM500,000 fine and imprisonment). Formal statutory clearance is mandatory.
questions.exp_bm: Melanggar Perintah Henti Kerja DOSH atau CIDB membawa penalti jenayah berat (denda sehingga RM500,000 dan penjara). Pelepasan berkanun rasmi adalah wajib.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: The Developer's Marketing Director pressures you to start piling on 10 March 2021 (Possession Date) even though DBKL has NOT yet approved the Earthworks Plan or Building Plan. As a Level 6 CCPM, what is your professional decision?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Pengarah Pemasaran Pemaju mendesak anda memulakan kerja cerucuk pada 10 Mac 2021 (Tarikh Milik Tapak) walaupun DBKL BELUM meluluskan Pelan Kerja Tanah atau Pelan Bangunan. Sebagai CCPM Tahap 6, apakah keputusan profesional anda?
options_en: Refuse to release permanent piling works (violates Act 133 Sec 70/70A), restrict site activities strictly to hoarding, survey & SI boreholes, and expedite OSC 3.0 Plus approval
Start piling secretly behind high hoarding
Ask the piling contractor to bear all DBKL criminal fines
Postpone all statutory submissions until 2022
options_bm: Tolak pelepasan kerja cerucuk kekal (melanggar Akta 133 Sek 70/70A), hadkan aktiviti tapak hanya kepada pemasangan pagar (hoarding), ukur & SI lubang jara, serta percepat kelulusan OSC 3.0 Plus
Mulakan kerja cerucuk secara rahsia di sebalik pagar tinggi
Minta kontraktor cerucuk menanggung semua denda jenayah DBKL
Tangguhkan semua penyerahan berkanun sehingga 2022
questions.exp_en: Permitting illegal site works exposes both developer and contractor to Section 70/70A prosecution and demolition orders; non-permanent enabling/SI works can proceed safely while expediting OSC.
questions.exp_bm: Membenarkan kerja tapak tanpa kelulusan mendedahkan pemaju dan kontraktor kepada pendakwaan Seksyen 70/70A dan perintah perobohan; kerja awalan/SI boleh dijalankan sementara mempercepat OSC.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: A specialist MEP subcontractor threatens to suspend chilled-water pipe installation under CIPAA 2012 because the main D&B contractor withheld payment citing a 'pay-when-paid' clause. How must the CPM intervene?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Subkontraktor pakar M&E mengugut untuk menggantung pemasangan paip air dingin di bawah CIPAA 2012 kerana kontraktor utama D&B menahan bayaran dengan memetik klausa 'pay-when-paid'. Bagaimanakah CPM mesti campur tangan?
options_en: Advise that 'pay-when-paid' clauses are void under CIPAA Sec 35, audit the verified work done immediately, and enforce prompt payment to prevent statutory suspension (CIPAA Sec 29) on the critical path
Support the main contractor's pay-when-paid excuse
Terminate the subcontractor without paying for certified work
Tell the subcontractor to wait until the 24-month DLP ends
options_bm: Nasihatkan bahawa klausa 'pay-when-paid' adalah batal di bawah Sek 35 CIPAA, audit kerja siap yang disahkan segera, dan kuatkuasakan bayaran segera bagi mengelak penggantungan berkanun (Sek 29 CIPAA) pada laluan kritikal
Sokong alasan pay-when-paid kontraktor utama
Tamatkan subkontraktor tanpa membayar kerja yang telah disahkan
Beritahu subkontraktor supaya menunggu sehingga DLP 24 bulan tamat
questions.exp_en: Under CIPAA Section 29, an unpaid party who wins adjudication can legally suspend work—which would devastate the Setiawangsa critical path and trigger RM10,500/day LAD.
questions.exp_bm: Di bawah Seksyen 29 CIPAA, pihak tidak dibayar yang menang adjudikasi boleh menggantung kerja secara sah—yang akan melumpuhkan laluan kritikal Setiawangsa dan mencetuskan LAD RM10,500/hari.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: During post-pour ultrasonic testing, 200 sq m of imported ceramic floor tiles already laid in the concourse are found to lack CIDB PPS certification. What is the compliant resolution under Act 520?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Semasa ujian ultrasonik selepas pemasangan, 200 m² jubin lantai seramik import yang telah dipasang di ruang legar didapati tidak mempunyai sijil PPS CIDB. Apakah penyelesaian yang patuh di bawah Akta 520?
options_en: Issue an NCR, hack out and replace the 200 sq m with CIDB PPS-certified tiles at the defaulting trade's cost, and tighten gate-entry PPS checks to prevent recurrence
Ignore it because tiles are already grouted
Ask the tiles supplier to forge a certificate
Paint over the tiles
options_bm: Keluarkan NCR, pecahkan dan gantikan 200 m² tersebut dengan jubin bertauliah PPS CIDB atas kos pihak yang cuai, serta ketatkan semakan PPS di pintu masuk tapak
Abaikan kerana jubin sudah siap digrout
Minta pembekal jubin memalsukan sijil
Cat di atas permukaan jubin tersebut
questions.exp_en: Ceramic tiles are Fourth Schedule items under Act 520; leaving non-compliant materials installed risks CIDB penalties up to RM500,000 and QLASSIC failure.
questions.exp_bm: Jubin seramik ialah item Jadual Keempat di bawah Akta 520; membiarkan bahan tidak patuh terpasang berisiko dikenakan penalti CIDB sehingga RM500,000 dan kegagalan QLASSIC.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: At Week 124, 19 of the 21 Borang G forms are signed, but Borang G8/G9 (Fire Fighting Passive & Active) is delayed because smoke-spill fans failed Bomba's witness test. Can the PSP legally issue Borang F (CCC) so tenants can open on schedule?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Pada Minggu ke-124, 19 daripada 21 borang G telah ditandatangani, tetapi Borang G8/G9 (Sistem Kebakaran Pasif & Aktif) tertangguh kerana kipas nyah-asap gagal ujian saksi Bomba. Bolehkah PSP mengeluarkan Borang F (CCC) secara sah supaya penyewa boleh beroperasi mengikut jadual?
options_en: No — Borang F (CCC) cannot be legally issued until Borang G8/G9 and Bomba clearance are signed; rectify fan airflow, re-test with Bomba, and expedite sign-off
Yes — issue Borang F first and fix fire fans next year
Yes — skip Borang G8/G9 because 19 out of 21 is >90%
Yes — ask DBKL to waive fire safety rules
options_bm: Tidak — Borang F (CCC) tidak boleh dikeluarkan secara sah sehingga Borang G8/G9 dan pelepasan Bomba ditandatangani; baiki aliran udara kipas, uji semula bersama Bomba, dan percepat kelulusan
Ya — keluarkan Borang F dahulu dan baiki kipas kebakaran tahun depan
Ya — langkau Borang G8/G9 kerana 19 daripada 21 ialah >90%
Ya — minta DBKL mengecualikan peraturan keselamatan kebakaran
questions.exp_en: Issuing Borang F without valid Borang G8/G9 and Bomba clearance is a serious statutory offence under Act 133 and UBBL 1984 and endangers public lives.
questions.exp_bm: Mengeluarkan Borang F tanpa Borang G8/G9 dan pelepasan Bomba yang sah ialah kesalahan berkanun serius di bawah Akta 133 dan UBBL 1984 serta membahayakan nyawa orang awam.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: Heavy monsoon rain washes silty water from the Setiawangsa site into the public drain, prompting a DBKL warning notice. Which immediate engineering and governance actions should the CPM execute?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Hujan monsun lebat menghanyutkan air berkelodak dari tapak Setiawangsa ke dalam parit awam, menyebabkan notis amaran DBKL dikeluarkan. Apakah tindakan kejuruteraan dan tadbir urus segera yang perlu dilaksanakan oleh CPM?
options_en: Desilt sediment traps immediately, reinforce perimeter silt fences/berms to JPS MSMA standards, verify wheel-wash operation, and submit photographic compliance proof to DBKL
Pump all muddy water directly into the neighbouring housing drain at night
Remove all silt traps to let water flow faster
Blame the weather forecast and take no site action
options_bm: Nyah-enap perangkap kelodak serta-merta, kukuhkan pagar kelodak/benteng perimeter mengikut standard JPS MSMA, sahkan operasi kolam basuh tayar, dan kemukakan bukti pematuhan bergambar kepada DBKL
Pam semua air berlumpur terus ke parit perumahan bersebelahan pada waktu malam
Buang semua perangkap kelodak supaya air mengalir lebih laju
Salahkan ramalan cuaca dan tidak mengambil sebarang tindakan di tapak
questions.exp_en: Immediate ESCP rectification prevents a DBKL Stop-Work Order (saving RM10,500/day LAD exposure) and ensures compliance with Act 133 and EQA 1974.
questions.exp_bm: Pembaikan ESCP segera mengelakkan Perintah Henti Kerja DBKL (menyelamatkan pendedahan LAD RM10,500/hari) dan memastikan pematuhan Akta 133 serta EQA 1974.

questions.q_en: CRISIS SCENARIO: Mid-way through construction, the D&B design team proposes reducing slab reinforcement and fire-compartment wall thickness without PE/Architect approval to recover a RM1.5M steel price spike. How must the CPM respond?
questions.q_bm: SENARIO KRISIS: Di pertengahan pembinaan, pasukan reka bentuk D&B mencadangkan pengurangan tetulang keluli papak dan ketebalan dinding petak kebakaran tanpa kelulusan PE/Arkitek bagi menampung kenaikan harga keluli RM1.5J. Bagaimanakah CPM mesti bertindak balas?
options_en: Veto the proposal immediately—structural safety and UBBL/Bomba fire ratings are non-negotiable statutory mandates; instead pursue legitimate Value Engineering (VE) or contingency drawdown
Approve the reduction quietly to protect profit margin
Allow thinner walls only on the top 3 floors
Reduce concrete cement content as well
options_bm: Veto cadangan tersebut serta-merta—keselamatan struktur dan kadar rintangan api UBBL/Bomba ialah mandat berkanun yang tidak boleh dikompromi; sebaliknya laksanakan Kejuruteraan Nilai (VE) yang sah atau pengeluaran luar jangka
Luluskan pengurangan secara senyap untuk melindungi margin keuntungan
Benarkan dinding lebih nipis hanya pada 3 tingkat teratas
Kurangkan juga kandungan simen dalam konkrit
questions.exp_en: Under Act 520 Sec 34A, Act 133, and Act 341, compromising structural or fire safety is illegal and unethical. Cost recovery must never violate statutory codes.
questions.exp_bm: Di bawah Sek 34A Akta 520, Akta 133, dan Akta 341, mengkompromi keselamatan struktur atau kebakaran adalah menyalahi undang-undang dan tidak beretika.
questions.ref: CCPM Module 01 & M11 — Statutory Boundaries in VM

questions.q_en: FINAL CAPSTONE SYNTHESIS: Which integrated principle best summarizes a Level 6 CCPM's governance philosophy across the entire construction project life cycle?
questions.q_bm: SINTESIS PENUTUP: Prinsip bersepadu manakah yang paling tepat merumuskan falsafah tadbir urus CCPM Tahap 6 merentasi keseluruhan kitaran hayat projek pembinaan?
options_en: Proactive stage-gate governance linking statutory compliance, verified baselines, measurable QA/HSE/cost controls, and auditable evidence at every handover gate
Focusing solely on lowest initial price while ignoring safety, quality, and statutory approvals until completion
Managing the entire RM180.5M project through informal verbal instructions without written records
Treating the Project Management Plan as a decorative shelf document never updated during construction
options_bm: Tadbir urus pintu peringkat (stage-gate) proaktif yang menghubungkan pematuhan berkanun, garis dasar disahkan, kawalan QA/HSE/kos terukur, dan bukti boleh diaudit pada setiap gerbang serahan
Memberi tumpuan semata-mata pada harga permulaan terendah sambil mengabaikan keselamatan, kualiti, dan kelulusan berkanun sehingga siap
Mengurus keseluruhan projek RM180.5J melalui arahan lisan tidak rasmi tanpa rekod bertulis
Menganggap Pelan Pengurusan Projek sebagai dokumen hiasan di rak yang tidak pernah dikemas kini semasa pembinaan
questions.exp_en: True Level 6 CCPM competency integrates statutory law, technical baselines, proactive risk/cost/quality controls, and auditable stage gates from inception to O&M.
questions.exp_bm: Kompetensi CCPM Tahap 6 yang sebenar mengintegrasikan undang-undang berkanun, garis dasar teknikal, kawalan risiko/kos/kualiti proaktif, dan pintu peringkat boleh diaudit dari permulaan hingga O&M.
